greet: Welcome to the {explorer society} headquarter of Svargrond, |PLAYERNAME|!
Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!

reply: That's fine.
And who would you like to marry?
Would you like to get married? Make sure you have a wedding ring and the wedding outfit box with you.
Then go bring them here!
Good, let's {begin} then!
Is your soulmate and friends here with you for the celebration?
I heard he moved to a dungeon.
Thank you, I'm fine, and humble in the knowledge that the Gods are with me.
Ice cream?? What ... ice cream you are talking about?
He is a favourite of the Gods of Evil and one of their Champions. He will have his come uppance one day.
This fabled weapon was lost in ancient times. The person who finds it will be all but invincible.
They are creatures of the Gods of Evil!
May the Gods protect him. And others around him. It's not easy living the way he does. Nor is it safe.
Once, all elements were one. But when Tibiasula was murdered by Zathroth, fire, water, air and earth were birthed.
I don't care about worldly celebrations.
I am a priest of the great pantheon.
The things I know about our citizens are confidential.
Bastesh, the deep one, is the Goddess of the sea and its creatures.
Well, as a priest I can tell you everything about blessings. I can also carry out a marriage ceremony to bind your and your beloved's soul together.
Fardos is the Creator, the Great Obsever. He is our caretaker.
Crunor, the Great Tree, is the father of all plant life. His branches provide shade and his sturdiness provides wisdom. He is an important God for many druids.
Nornur is the mysterious God of Fate. Who knows if he is its creator or just a chronist?
The world of Tibia is the creation of the Gods.
It is MY mission to teach, it is YOUR mission to fight!
He is a follower of evil. The Gods will punish him in due course.
Kirok, the Mad One, is the god of scientists and jesters.
Banor, the Heavenly Warrior, is the patron of those who combat evil. He is the gift of the Gods who inspires humanity.
My name is Lynda. And the spirits tell me that you are |PLAYERNAME|.
Sorry, I have had no enlightening visions lately.
King Tibianus is our benevolent sovereign.
It is MY mission to teach, it is YOUR mission to fight!
Life is a gift of the Gods. Therefore, you should honour life and don't destroy it.
The Gods of Good guard us and guide us and value life, the Gods of evil want to destroy us and steal our souls!
The Gods we call Good are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
Uman is the positive aspect of magic. He brings us the secrets of the arcane arts.
Suon is the Life Bringing Sun. He observes the creation with love and blesses us with warmth and growth.
Toth, the Lord of Death, is the keeper of the souls, the guardian of the afterlife.
Sula is the essence of the elemental power of water.
Fire is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
I am a priest of the great pantheon.
Air is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
Would you like to learn {Ultimate Healing Rune} Rune spell for 1500 gold?
Would you like to learn {Intense Healing Rune} spell for 600 gold?
Would you like to learn {Cure Poison Rune} spell for 600 gold?
Would you like to learn {ultimate healing} magic spell for 1000 gold?
Would you like to learn {intense healing} magic spell for 350 gold?
Would you like to learn {cure poison} magic spell for 150 gold?
Would you like to learn {light healing} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {magic patch} magic spell for free?
I can teach you {healing} spells and spells for {runes}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? I can also tell you which spells are available at your {level}.
My healing spells are: {Cure Poison}, {Intense Healing}, {Light Healing}, {Magic Patch} and {Ultimate Healing}.
My rune spells are: {Cure Poison Rune}, {Intense Healing Rune} and {Ultimate Healing Rune}.
For level 30 I have {Ultimate Healing} for 1000 gold.
For level 24 I have {Ultimate Healing Rune} for 1500 gold.
For level 20 I have {Intense Healing} for 350 gold.
For level 15 I have {Cure Poison Rune} for 600 gold and {Intense Healing Rune} for 600 gold.
For level 10 I have {Cure Poison} for 150 gold.
For level 8 I have {Light Healing} for free.
For level 1 I have {Magic Patch} for free.
I have spells for level {1}, {8}, {10}, {15}, {20}, {24} and {30}.

walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

farewell: May your path always be even.
greet: Nature's blessings! Welcome to the land of dreams.
walkaway: May your path always be even.

You think the full moon is a romantic affair? Think again!

greet: Ah, another one drawn here by the promise of moonsilver, I presume. I am the mayor of what remains of this {settlement}.

reply: Salgadora. Or what remains of it, at least. Most of our people {fled} when the creatures came. Fisherfolk, families... gone. I stayed. Someone had to.
What you see now is no longer truly ours. The {newcomers} have taken over much of it. Researchers, mercenaries, opportunists. They build their houses, but they do not belong here.
They tolerate each other. Barely. Everyone watches everyone else. Alliances are temporary things in times like these. At least the fight against the {creatures} unites us all.
We call them moonspawn. They come in waves. Relentless. Mindless. If we falter even once, this place will be {overrun}.
When the alarm sounds, everyone who can hold a weapon is {expected} to do so. No exceptions.
If you intend to involve yourself here, then start by {proving} that you are more than just another scavenger.
The south is where the {fragment} lies. Where the land itself changed. People who go there unprepared rarely return.
That is the largest fragment said to have fallen from the moon. All of the factions here {covet} it.
Yet the moonspawn, and the constant distrust and sabotage among the factions, {prevent} any serious exploration.
Worse still, recent rumors that someone has already begun tampering with the fragment have set everyone at each other's {throats}.
They {suspect} one another of secretly mining precious moonsilver and blindsiding the others.
I cannot tell how much of that is true, nor who might be behind it.
But you, as an outsider, have far more {leeway} to head south and investigate.
As I said, doing so without proving your worth would be suicidal. Earn some {trust} here, fight with us, and you will be free to explore.
There are hazards enough along the way without paranoid factions deciding you are part of the problem.
If you are serious about heading south, then do so with a secure {base} at your back. Earn your place here first. Then we will talk about further steps.
First do your part. If you are not willing to help, stay out of the way. We have enough problems without dead heroes cluttering the streets.
Pocaro. Mayor of Salgadora, for whatever that is still worth.
I am the mayor of Salgadora. Still in service of our {kingdom}, I guess, and for what that is worth.
This land was not always as you see it now. Long before your kind set foot here, it was known as the Coral Kingdom of Thalassara.
The capital, Coralmar, stood behind {reefs} that made it unreachable from the sea. A kingdom shaped by the tides, and protected by them.
That is until that rock broke off, supposedly from the moon.
Even before all this, Coralmar could not be reached from the sea. The reefs would tear apart any ship that dared approach.
Now? If anything still lives there, it is beyond our reach.
Their numbers grew, while ours dwindled. The cost of holding the land became too great.
So a {wall} was raised. Everything beyond it was abandoned.
All who were willing were evacuated on the {king}'s decree. Those who refused, well, they stayed here. Like me.
King {Marinho} remained in Coralmar. Or so we are told. Since the wall was sealed, no word has reached us.
For all we know, the capital still stands. Though it might have long since fallen.
He is a good man. The people love him. But he listened to the wrong voices. Too many advisors, too many promises. When it mattered, he hesitated.
Six generations of fishermen, and now we are a mining camp with a moon problem.
The island was quiet before the sky broke. Now everyone with a ship and a shovel calls it theirs.
It pays better than fish and it kills faster than the sea. That is all I need to know about it.
Then came the fall. A fragment of the moon struck the south. And with it, the first of the moonspawn appeared.
At first, they thought they could master them. Control them. There were even some successes.
When that rock fell from the sky, it disrupted the flow of the Rionda River. The town of Recifar, once settled along its banks, suffered severely and the surrounding land sank into swamp.
At first they tried irrigation and pumps, but then the moonspawn made their first appearance. In the end, the town was abandoned and lost.
The doctor? He came, he took, he vanished. If the cult has him, he earned it.

There's so much green stuff down there that I'm not sure whether there are any, but yes, might be, might be.
Well, dwarves and their steamboat technology are well and good, but nothing beats flying on a carpet.

That's the name of that dwarven base as far as I know. Got a bit of a pessimistic ring to it if you ask me. Sounds to me like they're starving.

It's 2:55 pm right now. I think I'm five minutes late in my schedule.

I am healthy and vigilant.

greet: Welcome. Good you're showing up

reply: I am known as Minzy.
I've never considered to follow a profession. But people tend to call me a swamp witch because I sometimes make brews with unusual ingredients in my cauldron. So I guess that is what I am.
Not all witches are evil. Neither do all of us fit into such simple categories like good and evil at all. ...

greet: Welcome to the Horn of Plenty, |PLAYERNAME|. Sit down, have a {drink} or some {food}!

reply: I can offer you beer, wine, lemonade and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.

send_trade: Of course, take a look at my tasty offers.

entries.text: The Horn of Plenty is always open for tired adventurers.

reply: I can offer you lemonade, camel milk, and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.

greet: Greetings, traveller. It seems, you're a {guest} here, just like me.

entries.text: The menu of the day sounds delicious!
The last visit to the theatre was quite rewarding.
Such a beautiful and wealthy city - with so many opportunities ...

greet: Welcome to the magic emporium, child. Ask me for a trade if you need {runes}, {wands}, or spellbooks.
send_trade: Choose wisely! Or maybe you want to look only at <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

entries.text: Come in, young mages! Purchase the latest in runes and wands!
Perhaps I need to bake them hotter? Or was it longer?
Offering all sorts of magic equipment!
Now where did Alaistar put the wood for the new wands?
Hmmm.. Maybe those crushed gems caused the strange side effect?
Wands and rods, the true magician's weapons of choice!

greet: Hello there.

reply: I can forge the finest {weapons} for knights and warriors. They may wear them proudly and visible to everyone.
Would you rather be interested in a {knight's sword} or in a {warrior's sword}?

greet: Oh hello, I wasn't expecting anyone so soon ... What has Sterling told you?

reply: I am Morla, guardian of these turtles.
I watch over the wild turtles and their eggs on Aragonia.
An old friend of mine from Targuna. I bet he sent you here.
They've been capturing turtles and stealing eggs. Please put a stop to them!
My precious turtle eggs are scattered all over the island. Please rescue them!
I am the local representative of the explorer society.

Our noble society is dedicated to exploring the unknown. No location is too remote for our members to travel there ... No beast is too wild to be hunted. No treasure buried too deep to be unearthed ... Only the most dedicated and fearless adventurers may join our ranks.
Currently we maintain public bases in Port Hope and Northport.
The portals should be ready to be used now. If you have an orichalcum pearl with you, enter the portal.
Do you want to buy an orichalcum pearl for 80 gold?
The examination of scrolls with lizard writings is a valuable source of information. We buy such scrolls for 500 gold. Are you interested to sell one?
The examination of scrolls with lizard writings is a valuable source of information. We buy such scrolls for 500 gold. Are you interested to sell one?
Do you want to buy an atlas for 150 gold?
Do you want to buy a botanist container for 500 gold?
Do you want to buy a preparation kit for 250 gold?
Do you want to buy a crown backpack for 800 gold?
Do you want to buy an ectoplasm container for 750 gold?

greet: I demand an explanation of you entering our house without any invitation.

entries.text: JAAAAACK? EVERYTHING ALRIGHT DOWN THERE?
Oh dear, I can't find anything in here!
There is still some dust on the drawer over there. What where you thinking, Jane?
Jane!
<grumble> Maybe I should rearrange some warm currents to get rid of this horrible fog.
All these treasures I cannot reach... what a pity.

greet: Welcome, young adventurer. If you seek to help me with some things, I might have a little {quest} or {mission} for you.

reply: Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
There's three things that need to be found. You can look for an {amulet}, a {log book} or pick some rare {herbs}. Take your pick.

Well, those monsters have grown very uppity lately. There's a choice of three - mountain {trolls}, muglex clan {goblins} or, if you are up to it or together with some friends, there's a need to weed out some risky {minotaur} bruisers. Choose your target.
Mr Morris will do.
There's always someone who needs to be at the front, to take the first step into the unknown. My whole life has been full of such steps.
Ah, that old story of how it was named? I spread it around. Can't remember really what its origins are. Interesting archeological findings here, though.

Ah yes. Well, the magic that led us here seems to be most potent at a certain time, close before sunrise. Perhaps like a giant pulse, or beacon. Maybe the gods set it here, or a mad sorcerer, we don't know for sure yet... The portal deep down in the caves, resonating with magical energy where you came through, can maybe bring something else into this world as well. So it must be carefully guarded while we investigate the island for more clues... There are some very interesting archeological findings here on the island throughout. Seems the island has drawn some cults here, but why they are gone now, no one knows.
It seems that throughout its history, this island was inhabited by very different species. I like to study their remains.
Yeah. Long time I haven't been to that place. How's old Vascalir? Still hanging around in the academy? And Kraknaknork? Hah, I remember our brawl after that last card game. Fun times.
What about him? Is he in one of his dark moods again? That's his normal mood, I mean. Just buy your armor, weaponry and ammunition there and don't worry.
Tired of the academy, maybe, but not of teaching. If you need druid or sorcerer spells, go to him.
Ah, good old Hamish. A real wizard with potions. Will supply you with very useful magic equipment for hunting.
Exactly. Has a nice ring to it.
She's a good listener if you should still hesitate as to the choice of your definite vocation.
Well, for him it's always been just a question of ''Your gold or your life'' - gold it is nowadays. You can stash your loose change at ol' Abram, but make sure to withdraw it once you leave Dawnport!

Ran across Inigo a few times on some remote islands, years and years ago. Talked him into coming along here, and he seems to enjoy helping newcomers find their way. Passing his knowledge on to the next generation.
We found him here half-dead and fixed him up, now he fixes us dinner and roof beams. Definitely someone you should check out for food, a rope and a shovel.
Been together through many a desperate situation. A romantic underneath it all. Found the time to specialise on spells for paladins and knights somewhere along the way.
Be careful that he doesn't bore you to death with accountants of, well, your bank account history.
He's still down there? And what about the others of his group?
Ah, the goblin who sneaks around here now and then? Lives in a cave to the west, somewhere.

entries.text: I have a quest that needs doing. Interested?
Hmmm. Interesting. If only someone could help investigate this.
There's a task for an intrepid adventurer open! Any volunteers?
Hey, you. Yes, you. I could use your help.
<sigh> The Adventurers' Guild really should have equipped me with more man power. Who's to keep all those monsters in check?
So much to investigate, so little time...
Buying all sorts of creature products!

greet: You arrived in Tibia! The Multi-User Dungeon (c) 1997 CipSoft GmbH ...
Everything around you emits a cozy and warm feeling. Silence and a great calm clutches this place. The lights are out. There is not much to see here. You are in a room with MUD.

reply: I am known as MUD.
My role here is quest contact.

farewell: May Daraman be with you on your travels.
greet: Be greeted, foreigner under the sun of Darama. What brings you {here}?

reply: I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
This is our home - the land of the desert.
We will fight that city until we get back what belongs to us.
We avoid these places you call cities.
I would go crazy living in a cage like that.
We have nothing that would be of value for you.
That is the curse for not following the rules of the desert. No son of the desert has ever come back from the dead.
We have nothing that would be of value for you.

walkaway: May Daraman be with you on your travels.

I can teach you {attack} spells, {healing} spells, {support} spells and spells for {runes}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? I can also tell you which spells are available at your {level}.
My attack spells are: {Apprentice's Strike}, {Buzz}, {Creature Illusion}, {Energy Beam}, {Energy Wave}, {Explosion}, {Fire Wave}, {Great Energy Beam}, {Invisibility}, {Scorch} and {Summon Creature}.
My healing spells are: {Cure Poison}, {Intense Healing}, {Light Healing}, {Magic Patch} and {Ultimate Healing}.
My support spells are: {Find Fiend}, {Find Person}, {Great Light}, {Light}, {Magic Shield}.

My rune spells are: {Destroy Field} Rune, {Energy Field} Rune, {Energy Wall} Rune, {Fire Bomb} Rune, {Fire Field} Rune, {Fire Wall} Rune, {Great Fireball} Rune, {Heavy Magic Missile} Rune, {Light Magic Missile} Rune, {Poison Field} Rune, {Poison Wall} Rune, {Stalagmite} Rune and {Sudden Death} Rune.

For level 1 I have {Buzz} for free, {Magic Patch} for free and {Scorch} for free.
He's not as dumb as the average fighter but a warrior nonetheless.

I heard that a member of the Explorer Society was in fact searching for the First Dragon. What a foolish endeavour - please excuse this comment. A romantic idea and a brave venture but seriously: the First Dragon. It is just a myth! ... However the explorer found an ancient inscription underneath the city of Thais. Reportedly he discovered it in the small cave where the first time ever a dragon was sighted on Tibia.
They are rumoured to be hidden somewhere in the Plains of Havoc, far to the east.
They are rumoured to be hidden somewhere in the Plains of Havoc, far to the east.
These pits you refer to might be the legendary 'Pits of Inferno', also known as the 'Nightmare Pits'.
The dragon was ancient beyond compare. Eventually even he had to succumb to old age and flew to the dragon cemetery to die there. Or so it is told.

I heard that a member of the Explorer Society was in fact searching for the First Dragon. What a foolish endeavour - please excuse this comment. A romantic idea and a brave venture but seriously: the First Dragon. It is just a myth! ... However the explorer found an ancient inscription underneath the city of Thais. Reportedly he discovered it in the small cave where the first time ever a dragon was sighted on Tibia.
I wonder how he actually got these awesome powers.
The enchantments on this weapon must be awesome.
The king is a patron of the arcane arts.
There have been many generations of sorcerers in the past. Today, a lot of people want to join us.
A sorcerer spends his lifetime studying spells to gain power.
Your vocation is your profession. There are four vocations in Tibia: Sorcerers, paladins, knights, and druids.
She keeps the whole wisdom of our ancestors and leads our guild.
Simple farmers.
I don't think he's any competition. I rarely see him anyway and I don't deem his skills noteworthy.
We supply the army with some sorcerer recruits now and then.
He has some minor magic powers.
I don't like jokes about my name!
The wisdom of spellcasting is the source of power.

Arcian was a childhood friend of mine. We studied the art of sorcery together but later, our ways parted ... Whereas I stayed here to instruct young new sorcerers, he devoted his life to his own studies ... Since his experiments tended to become a bit dangerous and he wanted to further explore a magic phenomenon he discovered in the Plains of Havoc anyway, he moved there and took his wife and his two assistants with him ... We stayed in contact for a while and he maintained a one-way teleporter to the academy. As I was missing any message from him for some time, I travelled to the plains to learn what might have happened ... I found the house overrun by ghouls, and no living soul. I have to assume that those ghouls have killed them and dragged everyone in their lairs. I left as soon as I could ... I wouldn't have wanted to see what they've done to my old friend. It's a sad story indeed.

Porgol was a quite bright student, although a bit overambitious. I was surprised when he agreed to accompany my friend Arcian to the Plains of Havoc to support him in his studies ... I was quite sure he'd rather study at the Edron academy instead. But sometimes people surprise one in a positive way. All the more it is tragic he found his death in this assault of undead on Arcian's house.
Knights! Childs with swords. Not worth of any attention.
Simple farmers.
Simple farmers.
I don't know him.
Marvik and his sorcerers lack spells with real power.
Only his boss keeps him from being burnt to ashes.
Of course, power is the most important thing in the universe.

Laira was the wife of my childhood friend Arcian. She was a warm and caring person. I hope she had not to suffer for long as ... she was killed by the undead. Sorry, I don't want to speak about that matter anymore.
She is quite proud of her puny magic tricks.
A bar is no place that suits a scholar like me.
Pretty and compentent.
He has our permission to sell mana fluids.
He is rumoured to possess some secrets our guild might find ... interesting.
You may call me Muriel.
Time is unimportant.
Our guild is working on a new spell, but I won't give away any details yet.
The king is a patron of the arcane arts.
We supply the army with some sorcerer recruits now and then.
I don't know exactly where it is. Someone told me you have to pass some tunnels full of orcs, somewhere underneath the king's castle. But that might be just gossip.
He's not a jester but a poor joke himself.
I am the second sorcerer. I am selling spellbooks and spells.
A simple smith.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Greetings, two-leg.

reply: My name is Nihaka.
I'm the maharani's son, so I guess you could call me a prince.
My mother is Saraki, our maharani.
Silvertides is the city of the coast folk. You can find it in the south of Marapur, on one of the larger islands.

greet: Greetings, two-leg. What a rare sight around here.

reply: Nilavarna, of the Silvertides.
I lead the nagas of these shores. The sea tells me what it wants and I listen.
Our home. Where the tide meets the stone and neither one wins.
The moon goddess. She fell once and the stars carried her back. We have not forgotten.
Our shaman. He hears the tides the way you hear voices.
She cares for the beavers and knows the plants of the lagoon better than any scholar.
She keeps the shop and works the yukti. If the magic is off, she noticed first.
The gestures that shape magic. Ask Nipuna, she lives by them.

greet: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
Beware, if you go any further you will have to fight a large group of Chosen. This place is called the Fire Dragon Dojo. Tread carefully since these are lizard training grounds.

reply: The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient

We of the Grey Shadow clan are studying the ways of the Chosen. Our training is hard, encounters with the lizards often deadly. Every one of us fights on his own. Each one more deadly than the other. Under my lead we wil rise renewed, as the Shadow Nina.
I am Nina, leader of the Grey Shadow clan. Me and my followers, the Shadow Nina, are exploring the largely uncharted parts of the continent Zao.

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

farewell: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
greet: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.

entries.text: Welcome to the post office!
If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

entries.text: I'm selling magic equipment. Come and have a look.
If you need runes, this is the market stall for you!

greet: Greetings, traveller!

reply: Niral.
I keep the balance between the beast and the person here in Oskayaat.
He was one of us. Then he filled himself with moonsilver and stopped being anyone at all.
The moon goddess. We do not worship her the way the nagas do, but we respect what she can do.
The same runes that ended our uncontrolled were sickness. Drawn in blessed blue lava, they will silence the shard.
It runs in the old volcano on the eastern coast. Take a crystal flask and wear your moon mirror, or the heat will have you.
The beast can be controlled. The moon cannot. Never confuse the two.

greet: You are....kind of tall! Hello.
Ah, another diciple of the extreme... surviving the icy outdoors? Let me {help}! If you need some first aid out here, I can provide {healing} or grant you an {enhanced} blessing!

reply: I am able to grant you the heart of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you willing to part with that amount of wealth?

Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...
These blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
Well, as I am quite in a {fix} currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
Well, as I am quite in a {fix} currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.

I know of a mysterious djinn, bound to an existence of slavery far to the north of Tiquanda's jungles. He is bound to tell you his secrets and offer you the 'blood of the mountain'. ...
I do not know where exactly but I guess you must first dig that one out to actually talk to him.
I am one with nature, one with the ice and the cold. Names are of no worth out here. Out here, you face isolation and loneliness. Only your strength, willpower and {training} can keep you alive.

My life is one of hardship, hardship I chose freely. Endurance, strength and the power of the will are my only companions in this frigid wilderness. My strength comes from disciplined training and knowledge of the outdoors.

Woof!

<wiggles>

greet: Hm? Oh! Oh, yes a... visitor! Intruder? Benefactor...? Wha- what are you? If you want to pass through this cave, I may have to disappoint you. Or maybe not. It... depends. So, just passing through?
Psst, not that {loud}.
Welcome, pilgrim. How may I {help} you? Are you in need of {healing}?

reply: Here in the whiteflower temple you may receive the blessing of spiritual shielding. But we must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you still interested?
Here in the whiteflower temple you may receive the blessing of spiritual shielding. But we must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you still interested?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
Just ask in which of the five blessings you are interested in.

It is said that one enhanced blessing, the 'heart of the mountain', has been lost in the icy wastes of Svargrond. Find a nomad far to the west of these barren lands, hiding in the cold there, slightly above ground. ... It is also said that a mysterious djinn, bound to an existence of slavery, lies buried somewhere beneath the northern Tiquanda jungle. I cannot confirm whether this tale is true but if you find him, you shall also find the 'blood of the mountain'.
I am here to provide one of the five blessings.

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five blessings you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
My name is Norf.
I am here to provide one of the five blessings.

greet: Welcome, welcome! Have a seat! If you like a drink or something to eat, just ask me for a {trade}!

reply: Well, my name is {Norma}.
I used to be a merchant, but being a barkeeper is so much more fun. It's been my dream since I was a little girl.
It's about |TIME|. Time just flies, doesn't it?
To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
I've never been better! I love my new {job}!
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need a weapon.
As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
Ah, the monsters are far away. Let's party now!
If you really want to talk about dungeons, visit Dallheim on the bridge near my bar.
Ewww, I don't even want to think about the smell from the sewers right now!
Oooh, I wouldn't dare gossiping about the king. He might have his spies here somewhere, you know.
This is the world we live in, oh-oh-oh, and these are the hands we're given, oh-oh... oh, I'm sorry, I got carried away!
As a premium adventurer you have many advantages, you should check them out!
I serve the best drinks in town! What's it gonna be, lemonade? Wine? Milk? Beer? Just ask me for a {trade}!
The temple is a good place to visit if you're in urgent need for healing.
Well, the only help I could give you are some general {hints}. And a delicious {drink} along with it.
Well, the only help I could give you are some general {hints}. And a delicious {drink} along with it.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.

Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!

Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
<gets a dreamy look in her eyes>
Al Dee treats his customers friendly, but he's badmouthing them once he had a few beers.
I'm curious about her adventures. She really should come here more often!
He got lucky when Willie and him played a game of dice about who gets to farm on which side of the river. Ever since, Willie holds a grudge against him.
Hehe, that guy doesn't pretend to be anyone that he isn't. He is what he is - rude, but honest.
Oh shush! It's kinda disgusting when he walks in here with animal blood on his hands!
What Seymour doesn't teach you is how much fun you can have here!
I invited her to my bar, but she refused. Oh well, it was worth a try!
I think that poor guy never gets a break from work. At least he never comes here.
That guy seriously needs some partying and a girlfriend.
The oracle is on the top floor of the academy. You should go there once you are level 8 to leave this island.
I think it's rather strange that he lives here with his granddaughter. No one's ever seen the parents of {Dixi}.
I hate that name, it sounds so boring. Almost like 'normal'. I think I should change my name to something more exciting. Like... Marylin! Oh, what a glamorous sound!
She told me that she dreams of leaving this island to go on a big adventure.
They tell me strange stories about him and some monsters in a hole. Weird!
That girl thinks that she is soooo special and 'high society'. We used to be friends, but well, things change.
That's probably someone I'll never see in my bar.
<giggles> That monk with his holier-than-thou attitude hasn't anything against a good mug of wine now and then.
If you listen to him, you could get the impression my little bar is the devil himself. He says he has more work now keeping drunken adventurers in than monsters out of the city. Such an exaggeration!
If you listen to him, you could get the impression my little bar is the devil himself. He says he has more work now keeping drunken adventurers in than monsters out of the city. Such an exaggeration!

send_trade: Take all the time you need to decide what you want!

entries.text: Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
<sings> ... are a girl's best friieeend...
Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
Best place in town! Come to my bar!

walkaway: Hey, where are you going? We've just started!

greet: It's .. It's YOU! At last!! So what's this special proposal you would like to make, my friend?
Welcome to Carlin Furniture Store, |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.
My name is Nydala. I run this store.
It is |TIME|. Do you need a clock for your house?

send_trade: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?

farewell: Farewell, I hope you were satisfied with our service.
greet: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}!

reply: Well, how can I help you? Do you need some general {hints}? Or, if you're interested in a {trade}, just ask.
What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
{Al Dee} sells torches.
Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
It's about |TIME|. Yes, |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches for sale.
My name is Obi, just Obi, the honest merchant. If you like to {trade}, just ask.
I'm a merchant and the local {weapon} smith. If you like to see my quality wares or sell weapons to me, ask me for a {trade}.
As an adventurer you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
If I were you, I'd invest my money in quality steel rather than putting it in a so-called safe bank account!
Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
Ah, Rookgaard. Home sweet home, that's what it became for me, but I will always miss {Thais} and {Sam}.
Oh, Thais, I'll be back. One day, I'll be back.
My good old cousin Sam. Oh, how I miss him.
I think good practice is better than reading a boring book. Of course, you will need proper {equipment} to be able to get practice!
told them to let me sell food, but no! Sorry, you have to ask {Willie} or {Billy} on the farms west of here.
Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. One is right outside this shop and to the left. For more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the {guards}.
The bridge guard {Dallheim} is north of here, just follow the street, you can't miss it.
Sadly, not many merchants are as honest as I am.
I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Lily}.
There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Nature's for free.
I'm fine. It's a little hot near the crucible, but I enjoy the sound of forging {weapons}.
Just ask me for a {trade} to see which things I buy from you.
Oh, just upstairs. My granddaughter {Dixi} is in charge of selling armors and shields.
Oh, just upstairs. My granddaughter {Dixi} is in charge of selling armors and shields.
Oh, just upstairs. My granddaughter {Dixi} is in charge of selling armors and shields.
Yes, I'm selling weapons. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers and the things I buy from you.
Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.

I sell {weapons} of all kinds. Just ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my offers.
I sell {weapons} of all kinds. Just ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my offers.
I sell {weapons} of all kinds. Just ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my offers.
I sell {weapons} of all kinds. Just ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my offers.
I don't know how anyone could give up the flourishing business she led. She should have listened to me and find someone who continues that business for her.
I told him there was no danger, but he wouldn't listen to me, no one listens to me.
I suggested him opening a tourist guide company with me, Obi's and Santiago's, but he didn't approve. I really don't understand why.
An old woman shouldn't be treated like that, no way, that's bad.
Oh, this guy is so greedy, so greedy. Ripping off poor adventurers like you!
She is beautiful, very, very beautiful. I hope I can impress her somehow.
He's just like his cousin {Willie}.
This guy doesn't understand that he should entrust me with the food business, too. He really should do. Then he had time for his farm.
He shouldn't heal people for free, no he shouldn't. That would be a great source of income for the village that could be invested in enhancing the smithy.
Oh, what an endearing little girl, and she's working so hard to help me, even without receiving payment. Such a sweet little girl!
I don't like him, actually I dislike him deeply. He is so greedy that he doesn't want to share his profit he gains from health potions.
She ruins the market with her offers! This is bad for us honest merchants, really bad.
I knew it! I knew she would try to get the monopoly on potions in this village! But no one has listened to me!
The oracle, ah, such a weird being! It will lead you off this island once you are level 8, yes it will, mark my words.
I told everyone he will cause trouble. He talks people into giving him their money and putting it on the {bank}! They rather should leave it here with us honest merchants!
He is the head of the local academy. I encouraged him to sponsor you, but no one listens to Obi, no one listens to me, as usual.
Well, he just buys what no one else wants. Stuff that's long dead. I can live with that, yes, I can live with that.
What a hero, what a hero.
What a hero, what a hero.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares.

entries.text: Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons!
Buy your weapons here!
Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!

greet: A shadow preceded you. You wish?

entries.text: Hm.
Yes. I listen, master.
I understand.
Not yet, my brothers. Wait.

farewell: May your memories serve you well... or not at all.
greet: Greetings, adventurer! How can I help you?

reply: I am Oblivis, keeper of forgotten memories.
I have the power to make you forget certain {quests} you have completed, allowing you to experience them anew.
Some quests can be {reset} if you wish to attempt them again or choose a different path.
Some quests can be {reset} if you wish to attempt them again or choose a different path.
Forgetting is sometimes necessary to move forward. I can help you with that.
Memories can be a burden. I help those who wish to start anew.
By resetting certain quests, you can obtain achievements that were previously locked due to your past choices.

greet: Greetings, dear visitor |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: Maybe another time.
Do you seek a passage to the east end for |TRAVELCOST|?
Maybe another time.
Do you seek a passage to the west end for |TRAVELCOST|?
I can bring you either to the east end of Port Hope or to the west end of the town, where would you like to go?

greet: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Only rarely I can welcome {visitors} these days.

reply: I guard this humble temple as a monument for the order of the {nightmare knights}.
I guard this humble temple as a monument for the order of the {nightmare knights}.
My name is Oldrak.
These plains are not safe for ordinary travellers. It will take heroes to survive here.
I can't help you, sorry!
The greatest necromant who ever cursed our land with the steps of his feet. He was defeated by the nightmare knights.
This ancient order was created by a circle of wise humans who were called 'The {Dreamers}'. The order became {extinct} a long time ago.
Many perished in their battles against evil, some went mad, not able to stand their nightmares any longer. Others were seduced by the darkness.
They learned the ancient art of {dreamwalking} from some elves they befriended.
While the dreamwalkers of the elves experienenced the brightest dreams of pleasure, the humans strangely had dreams of {dark omen}.
They dreamed of doom, destruction, talked to dead, tormented souls, and gained unwanted insight into the {schemes of darkness}.
They figured out how to interpret their dark dreams and so could foresee the plans of the dark gods and their minions.
Using this knowledge they formed an order to thwart these plans, and because they battled their nightmares as brave as knights, they named their order accordingly.
It is rumoured to open the entrance to the pits of inferno, also called the nightmare pits. Even if I knew about this secret I wouldn't tell you.
Before the battles raged across them, they were called the fair plains.
That's where we are. The world of Tibia.
They created Tibia and all life on it ... and unlife, too.
Beware the foul undead!
Beware the foul undead!
A weapon of myth and legend. It was lost in ancient times ... perhaps lost forever.
Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of most powerfull magicwielders in ancient times and known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
I can offer you the holy tible for a small fee.
Now, it is |TIME|.

walkaway: Take care, it's dangerous out there.

greet: Hello, traveller! Be welcome!

reply: My name is Om'Wake Naha, which translates into 'has many things' in your language.
I am responsible for supplies and trade of the colony.
Our town, Rascacoon, is just a colony. Our ancestors came here from a place far away on a journey to see the all wonders the world has to offer.

greet: At last, a visitor! Welcome to my... humble abode. {Scroll} or {mission}?

entries.text: Typical. Easy come, easy go.
He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
<groan>
If I ever lay hands on him again...
Did you hear that, too?

greet: Oh, a customer! Welcome to my magic shop. What can I do for you?
Oh, a customer! Welcome to my magic shop. What can I do for you?
Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. You've come at a good time for our {project}.

entries.text: Great, another supply ship is due. How is a dwarf supposed to work under these conditions?
Ah, there's nothing like the sound of hammers in the morning.

greet: State the meaning of walls VB and VC of testimony.

reply: I am known as Opticorder Forge (NPC).
My role here is Guard.
I am Oressa Fourwinds, the {healer}.
If you are hurt my child, I will {heal} your wounds.
I can {heal} you if you are hurt. I can also help you choose your {vocation}.
Behind each of those doors, the equipment and skills of one vocation lies - sorcerer, paladin, knight or druid. ...
He has seen much, and likes to help the younger ones. If you have questions about what to do, or whom to ask for anything, go to Inigo.
Found a new way of living and took to it like a fish to water.
Ah. Some wounds never heal. <sighs> Shipwrecked in body and mind. Nowhere to go, so he doesn't leave.
He broods over problems he won't share. But maybe you can help him with a little quest or two.
He lives only for his experiments and potions
He is injured? Then I should see to his wounds. I will pack some herbs and be off presently. Thank you.
This is a strange place. Many beings are called to it. I dreamed of it long before I came here. ...
Something spoke to me, telling me I had to be its voice; a voice of the Oracle here for the sake of the adventurers that would come to defend {World} against evil and need to {choose} their destiny.
I have heard of it, yes.
I believe it has been lost. You should ask Mr Morris or some of the others about it.

entries.text: You can't take it all with you - sell your Dawnport things before you receive the gear of your definite vocation!
Leave all Dawnport things behind you and choose your destiny!
Come to me if you need healing!
Choose your vocation and explore the mainland!
Talk to me to choose your definite vocation! Become a knight, paladin, druid or sorcerer!
World needs brave adventurers like you. Choose your vocation and sail to the mainland!
Poisoned? Bleeding? Wounded? I can help!

greet: Don't waste time. Get me {out}.

entries.text: Help!
I'm trapped! Help me!
Please, somebody help!

greet: What's your business here with the {magicians}, |PLAYERNAME|?

reply: I can't imagine a better place to live.
Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities.
Hm, good question. Maybe old, wise man?
I'm used to being called old man. Simple as that.
I don't know what you're talking about.
Yes, it's a bit messy down there. Sorry.
Doesn't ring a bell.
He rarely comes here.
A man of the seas.
He used to visit me for a chat, but ever since that new tavern opened I haven't seen him much anymore.
He sometimes delivers fruit and vegetables to this quarter.
Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities.
I can't imagine a better place to live
I don't have anything that I could give you as a reward. Guess you aren't so selfless after all, huh?
They try to protect the city and do a decent job. Well - no, a poor job, I mean a poor job.
You can bring me a mug of tea if you want to.
You can bring me a mug of tea if you want to.

greet: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|. What is it?

reply: I think the gods are too busy to care about us mortals, hmm... that makes me feel godlike, too.
I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent {Durin}!
I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent {Durin}!
I have a job of great responsibility, mostly I keep annoying persons away from my boss.
You better don't ask, you wouldn't like the answer.
Ah, yes, yes, hail to King {Tibianus}! Long live the king and so on...
I overheard a conversation of officials, that magic will be forbidden soon.
My name is Oswald, but let's proceed, I am a very busy man.
Hey, I am not a shopkeeper, I am an important man!
It is nearly tea time, so please hurry!
It's rumoured that Sam does not forge all weapons himself, but buys them from his cousin, who is married to a cyclops.
If you want to see dungeons just don't pay your taxes.
It's beyond all doubt that certain sinister elements in our city have certain knowledge about this myth.
You are not the first one to ask about that. Am I the only one that preferes wine to such disgusting stuff?
What do you expect from ex-soldiers? He is nuts! Hacked on the head far too often.
Isn't he the artist formerly known as the prince?
I never found any rumour concerning him, isn't that odd?
They say she killed over a dozen husbands already.
This man lives in the darkness like a rat and is also as handsome as one of them. He surely is up to no good and often consorts with sinister strangers.
Just last week a one eyed man, who had a room at Frodo's, met him in the middle of the night.
He sells his scrolls far too expensive.
I was told he lost a body part or two in duels... if you know what I mean.
He is rumoured to summon kinky demons to... well you know.
You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!
Fascinating! Absolutely fascinating!
I heard he was a ladies' man in younger days. In our days he is rumoured to wear women clothes now and then.
A simple shopkeeper with minor intelligence.
They say he isn't truly dead. He was... or is a necromant after all.
Some say he is Ferumbras in disguise.
What a shame. He claimed to be the king of thiefs and was caught stealing some fruit.
Just between you and me, he can be quite a tyrant.
AHHHH!!! WHERE??? WHERE???
If there weren't so many people harassing me, life would be great.
You don't need not ask me about that, you are perfect in it.
There are people who talk about a rebellion against King Tibianus.
Eclesius... Eclesius... I think they say about him that he accidentally turned his assistant into a frog. So you better pay attention!
If there weren't so many people harassing me, life would be great.
You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!
Who knows what this old man is up to in his hideout when no one is watching?
Our sewer system is very modern, but crowded with rats and wannabe heroes.
There are people who talk about a rebellion against King Tibianus.
I heard about a sorcerer who was toasted by a misfired spell of himself.
She's a little witch, trust me. She used to be the girlfriend of this evil Partos some time ago.
Sweet as honey, but cold as a fish. The only thing that can soften her heart is this awfully expensive Venorean ice cream.
You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!
I heard Sam dated a female mud-wrestler once.

walkaway: Good bye, and don't come back too soon.

greet: Greetings!

reply: My name is Owin.
I'm actually a hunter. Or used to be, at any rate. But lately I made some efforts to find out more about the so called Curse of the Full Moon. So I'm also a kind of researcher by now.
At full moon humans transform into wild beasts: wolves, boars, bears and others. Some call it the Curse of the Full Moon, others think it is a kind of sickness.

I can teach you {attack} spells, {healing} spells, {support} spells and spells for {runes}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? I can also tell you which spells are available at your {level}.
My attack spells are: {Apprentice's Strike}, {Chill Out}, {Creature Illusion}, {Ice Wave}, {Invisibility}, {Mud Attack} and {Terra Wave}.
My healing spells are: {Cure Poison}, {Intense Healing}, {Light Healing}, {Magic Patch} and {Ultimate Healing}.
My support spells are: {Convince Creature}, {Find Fiend}, {Find Person}, {Food}, {Great Light}, {Light}, {Magic Shield} and {Summon Creature}.

I am the grand druid of Carlin. I am responsible for the guild, the fields, and our citizens' health.
Every druid is able to learn the numerous spells of our craft.
I am Padreia, grand druid of our fine city.
Time is just a crystal pillar - the centre of creation and life.
We are druids, preservers of life. Our magic is about defence, healing, and nature.
Sorcerers are destructive. Their power lies in destruction and pain.

greet: Greetings.
Salutations, |PLAYERNAME| I guess you are here for the {horses}.

reply: Did you know that minotaurs ride giant bulls? It seems somewhat strange, like a human riding a cyclops.
There is nothing big enough for a cyclops to ride.
Sorry, but the donkeys and the horses did not get along well with each other. So we sold all of the donkeys to the dwarfs.
Venore is the heart of trade and commerce. Not even Thais can rival Venore in that field.
Perhaps one day we will expand to Carlin. The women there will just love our ponies!
As far as I know, the goblins ride all kinds of creepy things like lizards, centipedes, spiders and slugs. Most of those beasts can even walk on the ceilings of caverns and climb walls with ease!
We loan mounts for a certain time. Those horses are easy to handle and loyal.

Most dwarfs don't like riding at all. Though I heard one of their heroes is riding a ram, they usually use horses and donkeys as beasts of burden. Given their size it is not astounding that they prefer the smaller donkeys over the horses.
The city is the centre of the known world. It is almost as if everything else is just built around it!
I heard the elves ride every animal that roams the woods. From wolves and bears to squirrels, the elves befriend and ride them all. Just amazing!
Be careful, the straw is highly inflammable.

We order our coaches from the dwarfs. They deliver high quality work that rarely breaks. Therefore we rarely have any delays. That is if there are no bandits, or monsters, or bad weather, or the horses are on the loose and such.
If we could convince the king to use one of our coaches on his next visit to Venore, our business would get a fundamental boost!
I can rent you a horse for a day or I can transport you with a coach.
Orcs ride wolves and sometimes boars, and even spiders, as far as one can trust the rumour mill.

greet: Welcome adventurer! I'm sensing some very unusual distortions in the fabric of reality recently. They are caused by an inactive portal right beside me. ...

reply: I am known as Para Norbert.
My role here is quest giver.

It is the world of the dead. Many sages believe, that it is located below the world of the living. Yet some think, it lies within another dimension so that terms like above or beneath are inappropriate to describe it. ...
There are some rumours that the descent to the Netherworld is difficult yet possible for those still living.

farewell: Good bye, visit me again. I will be here, promised.
greet: Welcome to my little kingdom, |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: You mean that's a JAIL? They told me it's the finest hotel in town! THAT explains the lousy roomservice!
You mean that's a JAIL? They told me it's the finest hotel in town! THAT explains the lousy roomservice!
You mean that's a JAIL? They told me it's the finest hotel in town! THAT explains the lousy roomservice!
I am great! Free food, free room, and now and then someone coming down here to ask me silly questions. Wouldn't you love that, too?
Bah, I did nothing serious. I just had a little fun. In Ankrahmun nobody would have cared about these kind of things...
Yeah sure, I go out with him all the time... NOT.
Rich enough to spare a little, don't you agree? Well, they didn't agree.
I bet one could get some fine ransom, if he dognaps this furball.
At least I am safe from them down here.
By the gods, he visits us 'criminals' now and then to 'save' us. Who is going to save me from this boredom on two legs?
Gold got me in here. But I'd offer you some gold for keys.
I love the city. I just wish I could see some other part of it now and then.
Yeah! Come in and let's have a party.
Bah, the king's pawns. I spit on them.
Gold got me in here. But I'd offer you some gold for keys.
I love the city. I just wish I could see some other part of it now and then.
Hey, most people I killed were even worse than me.
I hardly hear any news down here.
Geee, someone stole my watch. Bad company down here.
Yeah, a king is a man that can rob people by law, and not by night like me.
My name is Partos, but you can call me Party.
I sort of collect them. Broken key rings, that is. You never know. If you wanna trade, you know where to find me.
Guess it! I'll give you a hint: I am not in this cell to clean it up! ... I wish I had never left Ankrahmun...
The gods seldom show up down here, so don't ask me.

walkaway: Good bye, visit me again. I will be here, promised.

greet: Hello. I am Paulette.

reply: My name is Paulette. I represent just one colour. Violet. So take it or leave it.

I am here to inform you about the one right choice - Feiz of Power whose colour is violet. There are in fact two other wizards you could join but isn't violet the single most beautiful colour of them all? Exactly.
Feiz is the wizard of Power. Strength, influence and infinite might are his attributes. If you value these attributes, join him.
Fern is the wizard of Nature. Behold his powers and the elemental might that is nature itself.

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Greetings, young man. Looking for a passage or some fish, |PLAYERNAME|?

reply: Maybe later.
Do you seek a passage to Edron for |TRAVELCOST|?
Maybe later.
Do you seek a passage to Eremo for |TRAVELCOST|?
I'm a fisherman and I take along people to Edron. You can also buy some fresh fish.
I'm a fisherman and I take along people to Edron. You can also buy some fresh fish.
My fish is of the finest quality you could find. Ask me for a trade to check for yourself.
It's a lovely and peaceful isle. Did you already visit the nice sandy beach?
My name is Pemaret, the fisherman.

farewell: Farewell, and may Justice be with you!

reply: I am miss Penny, your secretary.
Yep, Penny's my name. You seem to be as smart as you're talkative.
I'm a secretary. I'm organising all those papers and your mail.
<Sigh> It's an evil world, isn't it?
<Sigh> It's an evil world, isn't it?
<Sigh> It's an evil world, isn't it?
You can get a letter from me.
Don't stare at me.

walkaway: Wait... will you take me a diamond when you're back?

greet: Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|!

reply: Can't you see? I am the greatest actor in the world!
Can't you see? I am the greatest actor in the world!
Haven't you heard of me? I'm Percybald, the Magnificent!

entries.text: Stop by before embarking on your great adventure! Distance weapons and general equipment on sale today!

farewell: I'm just a fisherman. I want no trouble. Please, leave me alone.
greet: I'm just a fisherman. I want no trouble. Please, leave me alone.

entries.text: All those worries.

walkaway: I'm just a fisherman. I want no trouble. Please, leave me alone.

greet: Hello. Unless you have official business here or want to pass the gate, please move on.

reply: There it's even more smelly than in the factory quarter. Smells a bit like rotten eggs.
You don't look as if you would last one second there.
One day I will walk into the office of my superior and announce my resignment. Probably not long from now.
Good idea. Go for a walk there. Preferably six feet down.
It's too noisy and smelly.
Go there if you wanna get beaten up.
Sergeant first class of the Yalaharian Guard Force. But I don't care about ranks and titles.
Sergeant first class of the Yalaharian Guard Force. But I don't care about ranks and titles.
I can't stand those arrogant fools.
Leave me alone with your 'mission' unless you have precise orders from my superiors.
Peter.
That quara brood should be extinguished.
The leader of their pack is the biggest criminal among them all.
Count them yourself.
You're here. So what?

greet: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?

reply: We would like to serve you some time.
Do you seek a passage to Venore for |TRAVELCOST|?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you seek a passage to Port Hope for |TRAVELCOST|?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you seek a passage to Liberty Bay for |TRAVELCOST|?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you seek a passage to Ankrahmun for |TRAVELCOST|?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you seek a passage to Gray Island for |TRAVELCOST|?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you seek a passage to Krailos for |TRAVELCOST|?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you seek a passage to Issavi for |TRAVELCOST|?
My boat is ready to bring you to {Venore}, {Port Hope}, {Liberty Bay}, {Yalahar}, {Gray Island}, {Ankrahmun}, {Krailos} or {Issavi}. Or to {Travora} - a place between the worlds.
I am the captain of this ship.
Where do you want to go - {Krailos}, {Venore}, {Port Hope}, {Liberty Bay}, {Ankrahmun}, {Yalahar} or {Gray Island}?
That's where we are.
It's Petros.

farewell: Go and be careful. Remember what you have learned!
greet: Hello, mighty adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. Can I teach you something you don't know?

reply: I am fine, thank you very much.
My business is knowlegde and it is for free.
I am honored to be teacher in this school.
I run this school, there are other travelling teachers who we call Loremasters.
If you are lucky you'll meet one in your journeys.
My name is Phillip.
It is |TIME|.
I will provide you with all knowledge I have.
Monsters come in different shape and power. It's said there is a zoo in the dwarfs' town.
Dungeons are places of danger and puzzles. In some of them a bright mind will serve you more then a blade.
An interesting place you should consider to visit.
You don't have to thank me, it's only my duty.
To learn about gods, visit the temples and talk to the priests.
The southern king is called Tibianus. He and our queen Eloise are in a constant struggle.
The southern king is called Tibianus. He and our queen Eloise are in a constant struggle.
I don't like rumours.
I don't like rumours.
I don't like rumours.
To learn about weapons read appropriate books or talk to the smiths.
To learn about magic talk to the guild leaders.
Rebellion? What for? We are contend with our situation.
Tod will come and save us all. He will bring freedom and beer to the men of Carlin.
This servant of evil is protected by the dark gods and can't be harmed.
He is a follower of evil. His powers were boosted by a sinister force and he is beyond human restrictions now.
This weapon is said to be very powerful and unique. It was hidden in ancient times and now is thought to be lost.

greet: Oink.

reply: Oh well. I am cursed to live in this unworthy shape but I still hope that the curse will be lifted one day.
You probably have the potential. If your kiss does not lift the curse, travel the world to learn more about kissing.
An evil witch has cursed me to live as a pig until the best kisser in the world gives me a kiss.

Learn as much about kissing as you can. I'm sure you can learn the basics in the major cities. To refine your skill you might need to travel to the countryside, explore sparsely populated areas and even face some dangers.
An evil witch has cursed me to live as a pig until the best kisser in the world gives me a kiss.
My name is Shantalla.
Where do you think I'd wear a watch?
Only a kiss of the king of all kissers will break the curse.
Don't kill me! I taste bad!
Once I was a beautiful princess but now I'm only an ordinary pig without much dignity!
It's just the appearance. Inside I am still the beautiful princess I used to be.

greet: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you?

reply: You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Darashia on Darama for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Darashia on Darama for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Kazordoon for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Kazordoon for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to the Femor Hills for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to the Femor Hills for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Svargrond for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Issavi for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Marapur for |TRAVELCOST|?
I can fly you to {Darashia}, {Issavi}, {Svargrond}, {Kazordoon}, {Zao}, {Femor Hills} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?

entries.text: Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!

reply: I am known as Planestrider (NPC).
My role here is quest contact.
I am and never was. The first final piece of a puzzle, put back into its box. But how many boxes are there, how many will there ever be? All of them. There will be all of them.

greet: Sorry, no time for gossip. I have to choose my reward.

reply: I am known as Player Level 999 (Male).
My role here is reward queue visitor.
Should I take this one or that one? I really don't know ...
The helmet also looks great ...

greet: Welcome, young adventurer! Harr! {Deposit} your gold or {withdraw} your money from your bank account. I can also explain the functions of your {bank} account to ya.

reply: Yeah, well, some romantic at work there. Island was reached at dawn, new heroes and adventurers forthcoming, stuff like that.
Ah, wonderful stuff! That and a bottle o' rum, o'course! Harrharr. You have some gold you want to deposit or withdraw, just tell me.
You can deposit and withdraw money from your bank account here.
Once you are on the Tibian mainland, you can access new functions of your bank account, such as changing money, transferring money to other players safely or taking part in house auctions.
Abram Plunderpurse, at your service. <bows>
Here on Dawnport, I run the bank. I keep any gold you deposit safe, so you can't lose it when you're out fighting or dying, heh. Ask me for your balance to learn how much money you've already saved
Arrr. Not a very profitable place.
Arr! I'm a pira... er, I mean <cough> <cough> ... clerk. Banking clerk. That's what I am. You need somethin'? Bank business, p'raps?

Aye, Tibia is a vast world, my friend, with plenty of adventures, harbours, and loot! The Mainland is open to everyone; but there are many beautiful islands and more cities to explore, if you have premium rights and can use a ship.
Once you have reached level 8 here on this isle, you can choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland.
There's a choice of four: knight, sorcerer, paladin or druid.
I'm afraid this service is not available to you until you reach the World mainland.
He's an ol' trapper and knows his away around in Tibia, aye. Ask him how a thing works and he'll be sure to have an answer. ...
Gloomy sort. Keeps glaring at me for some reason. Or maybe for no reason, harr. Formidable blacksmith, anyway. Sharpest sword blade I've seen in a long time.

Fetching white beard, I hope I grow one in due time, would impress the younger folk no end! Knowing some sorcerer and druid spells like he does wouldn't come amiss, either. Go to him if you need mage spells.
Could've used his talent to brew up some more explosive runes back in the sea fight against... ah well, you wouldn't know the name anyway. Gotta admit, his potions are good stuff.

<shifts uneasily> Well, maybe I did come across his ship some time. In bad weather. And couldn't do a thing for those poor souls. And anyway, he swam ashore here. So it all worked out in the end, see.
That's Mr Morris to you, friend. Go get yourself a useful thing to do and ask him about a quest, will you.
Harrr, what a dame! Would like to buy her a pint one day. <leers> Unless she kills me with one of her icy looks first. Anyway, decent healer. Can help ya with choosing a vocation.
Aye, what about my name? You don't like it? Well, you don't have to wear it! And I am quite happy with that!
Not my line of trade, friend! Mr Morris next door will tell you what needs doin' around here.
I could swear he looks like that old pal I met back on... ah well, much salt water passed my ship since then. If ye need a spell or two for a knight or paladin, he's the spell teacher to go to.
Arrr. We go wayyyy back, Keeran an' me. Best you ask him, I'm no good at details.
I'm a clerk now. I have better stuff to look after than just a simple key, friend.

entries.text: Waste not, want not!
Don't burden yourself with too much cash - store it here!
Don't take the money and run - deposit it and walk instead!

farewell: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
greet: Hello.
send_trade: Keep in mind you won't find better offers here. Just browse through my wares.

greet: Hello. I am Praline.

reply: I am known as Praline.
My role here is local resident.

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

entries.text: Ahhhh!
Have mercy!
I admit! I admit!
I repent!
Noooooo!
Please! I beg you to stop!
Take it away! Please!
