greet: Top o' the morning, traveller! Here to join the Great Expedition by helping to fund it, vote for a crew member, check its status, exchange your event points or customise our majestic ship? ...
Thing is, we're in quite a pickle here right now and could really need your help!

reply: I am known as Proprietor Piers.
My role here is entrepreneur and adventurer.

greet: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!

farewell: May the fire in your heart never die, |PLAYERNAME|!
greet: Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|! I can smell the scent of a phoenix on you!

reply: The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great geomancer of the local earth temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix for |BLESSCOST| gold?
The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great geomancer of the local earth temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix for |BLESSCOST| gold?
The Spark of the Phoenix is given by me and by the great geomancer of the local earth temple. Do you wish to receive my part of the Spark of the Phoenix for |BLESSCOST| gold?
The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
I am the head pyromancer of Kazordoon.
My name is Pydar Firefist, Son of Fire, from the Savage Axes.
Ask around. There's a lot to do, jawoll.
That is our world.
It's the fourth age of the yellow flame.
May the great flame devour them all!
Life feeds on fire and ultimately fire will feed on life.
A weapon too powerful to be wielded by mortals. It has to be returned to the fire which gave birth to it.
If he ever dares enter Kazordoon I will gladly dump him into the lava. Tthe sacred flame shall bring justice upon him.
Our city was founded in ancient times. Abandoned by the gods we once fought for, we created a secure haven for our people.
This mountain is said to be the oldest in the world. It is the place where fire and earth meet and separate at the same time.
Bezil and Nezil are buying and selling equipment of all kinds.
Bezil and Nezil are buying and selling equipment of all kinds.
She is the first knight of Kazordoon. She is responsible for teaching our young warriors how to handle an axe.
Etzel is a true master of the elements. He is a role-model for our youngsters, jawoll.
He and his wife are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
He is a smith. If you are looking for exquisite weapons and armour just talk to him.
She and her husband are running the Jolly Axeman tavern.
Uzgod is a weaponsmith just like those in the old legends.
Though we are through with the so-called gods, Durin, the first dwarf to aquire divine powers of his own, is considered a protector of our race.
Unlike the gods, the elements don't use mortals as toys, A skilled mind can understand and even control them to some extent.
The ways of the gods are imprehensible to mortals. On the other hand, the elements are raw forces and can be understood and tamed.
You can receive the Spiritual Shielding in the Whiteflower Temple south of Thais.
Ask for the Fire of the Suns in the Suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
The druids north of Carlin can provide you with the Embrace of Tibia.
Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
I'm the head pyromancer of Kazordoon. I guess you are here for healing or looking for a blessing.

There are five different blessings available in five sacred places. These blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
We are the keepers and shepherds of the elemental force of {fire}.

walkaway: May the fire in your heart never die.

farewell: COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.
greet: I {AWAITED} YOU!

reply: ALRIGHT. BUT FIRST OF ALL I WANT YOU TO BRING ME SOMETHING IN EXCHANGE. SURPRISE ME....AND IF I LIKE IT, YOU MAY GET WHAT YOU DESERVE.
HAVE YOU SEEN THESE LEGENDARY ITEMS BACK THERE? WHO COULD REFUSE THE CHANCE OF OBTAINING ONE?!? SO WHAT IS YOUR ANSWER?
LIKE MY TREASURE? WANNA PICK SOMETHING OUT OF IT?
I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY {TREASURE}. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!!
I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN {UNDEAD} CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL.
BOON AND BANE. I HAVE CHOSEN THIS LIFE VOLUNTARILLY AND I NEVER REGRET IT. MY {TREASURE} IS GROWING BIGGER EACH DAY.

walkaway: COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME TREASURES.

reply: Alright then, come back when you are ready.
I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
I am {Queen} Eloise. It is my duty to reign over this marvellous {city} and the {lands} of the north.
I am {Queen} Eloise. It is my duty to reign over this marvellous {city} and the {lands} of the north.
We women try to bring justice and wisdom to all, even to males.
I am Queen Eloise. For you it's 'My Queen' or 'Your Majesty', of course.
I don't care about gossip like a simpleminded male would do.
Soon the whole land will be ruled by women at last!
Soon the whole land will be ruled by women at last!
Thank you, I'm fine.
It's my humble domain.
Sell? Your question shows that you are a typical member of your gender!
We honor the gods of good in our fair city, especially Crunor, of course.
All citizens of Carlin are my subjects. I see them more as my childs, though, epecially the male population.
This beast scared my cat away on my last diplomatic mission in this filthy town.
He is the scourge of the whole continent!
The royal treasure is hidden beyond the grasps of any thieves by magical means.
Go and hunt them! For queen and country!
Visit the church or the townguards for help.
I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again.
I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again.
Our city is rich and prospering.
Our city is rich and prospering.
Our city is rich and prospering.
I don't want to talk about 'sewers'.
Dungeons are places where males crawl around and look for trouble.
Feel free to visit our town's magnificent shops.
Feel free to visit our town's magnificent shops.
Don't worry about time in the presence of your Queen.
We need the assistance of heroes now and then. Even males prove useful now and then.
We need the assistance of heroes now and then. Even males prove useful now and then.
The taxes in Carlin are not high, more a symbol than a sacrifice.
I am the Queen, the only rightful ruler on the continent!
Ask one of the soldiers about that.
Our enemies are numerous. We have to fight vile monsters and have to watch this silly king in the south carefully.
Our enemies are numerous. We have to fight vile monsters and have to watch this silly king in the south carefully.
They dare to reject my reign over them!
They dare to reject my reign over them!
Isn't our city marvellous? Have you noticed the lovely gardens on the roofs?
Isn't our city marvellous? Have you noticed the lovely gardens on the roofs?
My subjects maintain many fine shops. Go and have a look at their wares.
Ask around about them.
Ask around about them.
The four major guilds are the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
They haven't troubled our city lately. I guess, they fear the wrath of our druids.
The paladins are great hunters.
The paladins are great hunters.
It's a shame that the High Paladin does not reside in Carlin.
The knights of Carlin are the bravest.
The knights of Carlin are the bravest.
The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does not burn the whole city to ruins.
The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does not burn the whole city to ruins.
The druids of Carlin are our protectors and advisors. Their powers provide us with wealth and food.
The druids of Carlin are our protectors and advisors. Their powers provide us with wealth and food.
Carlin is a center of the forces of good, of course.
The forces of evil have a firm grip on this puny city to the south.
The order, Crunor gives the world, is essential for survival.
Chaos is common in the southern regions, where they allow a man to reign over a realm.
A mans tale ... that means 'nonsense', of course.
If you want a reward, go and bring me something this silly King Tibianus wants dearly!
A dusgusting organisation, which could be only created by men.
It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
A hard man but his heart is in the right place.
Hush! Do not mention the Evil One in these walls.
Legends tell us that that Excalibug is a gift of the gods. Banor used in his battles. They say it was passed on to one of his followers.
First you should buy a bag or backpack. That way your hands will be free to hold a weapon and a shield.
Our king resides in the castle to the west.
The McRonalds run the local farm.
I hope I won't become that forgetful when I'm old. But he is a good man, although I don't know him very well.
Harkath Bloodblade is his name.
Just walk around, you will see grass, trees, and bushes.
I am a simple monk. I just know Sam, Frodo, and Gorn. They all live in the main street to the north.
Muriel is a famous sorcerer. He is the keeper of arcane secrets that are known only to few mortals.
The leader of the Knights' guild is a man of few words.
I admire the healing skills of Marvik.
He is the guard of the royal castle.
This man is spreading horrible rumours all the time.
The McRonalds run the local farm.
The McRonalds run the local farm.
There are spiders' nests beyond our city near Gorn's shop and at the McRonalds' farm in the east.
That is where we are. The world of Tibia. Admire its beauty.
He is the owner of Frodo's Hut, the tavern north of this temple.
She is the leader of the local Paladins' guild.
She is a highly competent priest.
Please do not mention the fallen one.
If you need money you should slay monsters and take their gold. Look for spiders and rats.
You can enter the sewers thorugh a sewer grate. But watch out. There are many rats. And don't forget to bring a torch.
Take a weapon into your hand and select a target. If you are wounded you should eat some food to heal your wounds.
My name is Quentin.
Sorry, I know nothing new. Please ask Frodo about that topic.
On Tibia there are many forms of life. There are plants and people and monsters.
Our king resides in the castle to the west.
I don't know much about the Tibian army. Ask general Harkath Bloodblade about that.
He is selling equipment. If you still have no backpack you should go and ask him for one.
He is the king's jester, but he believes himself to be the king of fools.
If you need money you should slay monsters and take their gold. Look for spiders and rats.
Take a weapon into your hand and select a target. If you are wounded you should eat some food to heal your wounds.
If you would like to heal your wounds you should eat some food. Frodo sells excellent meals. But if you are very weak you can also come to me. I will heal you.
Job? I have no job. I just live for the gods of Tibia.
They created Tibia and all life on it.
He is our blacksmith. He sells weapons and armour.
There are sewers underneath the city. They say these sewers are brimming with rats.

reply: He's nice.
That name rings a bell, wait... I've last seen him several days ago when he went to buy some bread at the farm.
I love the music of the elves.
They live in the northeast of Tibia.
Yes, I have a small daughter. Her room is upstairs.
I wonder why this matters to you. But yes, my daughter lost her first tooth a few days ago.
My name is Quero.
Sorry, I don't know what time it is.
Selling instruments isn't enough to live on and I love music. That's why I wander through the lands from time to time.
I make instruments and sometimes I'm wandering through the lands of Tibia as a bard.
They live in the northeast of Tibia.
Yes, I have a small daughter. Her room is upstairs.

greet: Ah, a customer! Please feel free to browse my wares, |PLAYERNAME|.
send_trade: Have a look. But perhaps you just want to see my <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

greet: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Whats your need?

reply: Okay, then just browse through all of my wares.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

reply: Are you here to get a task or to report you finished task?
Me humble name is Rafzan. Good old goblin name meaning honest, generous and nice person, I swear!
Most goblins so afraid of everything, that they fight everything. Me different. Me just want trade.
You humans are so big, strong, clever and beautiful. Me really feel little and green beside you. Must be sooo fun to be human. You surely always make profit!
To be honest to me human friend, me only heard about it, never seen one. I imagine it's something cute and cuddly.
Swamp is horrible. Slowly eating away at health of poor little goblin. No profit here at all. Me will die poor and desperate, probably eaten by giant mosquitoes.
Beardmen are nasty. Always want to kill little goblin. No trade at all. Not good, not good.

So much to do, so little help. Me poor goblin desperately needs help. Me have a few tasks me need to be done. I can offer you all money I made if you only help me a little with stuff which is easy to strong smart human but impossible for poor, little me.

Me heard Thais is big city with king! Must be strong and clever, to become chief of all humans. Me cannot imagine how many people you have to beat up to become king of all humans. Surely he makes lot of profit in his pretty city.

They are mean and cruel. Humble goblin rarely trades with them. They would rather kill poor me if not too greedy for stuff only me can get them. Still, they rob me of it for a few spare coins and there is noooo profit for poor goblin.

Me job merchant is. Me trade with all kinds of things. Me not good trader though, so you get everything incredibly cheap! You might think me mad, but please don't rip off poor goblin too much. Me has four or five wives and dozens of kids to feed!

Humans so clever. Much, much smarter than poor, stupid goblin. They have big rich town. Goblin lives here poor and hungry. Me so impressed by you strong and smart humans. So much to learn from you. Poor goblin only sees pretty city from afar. Poor goblin too afraid to go there.

Me have seen a gold coin once or twice. So bright and shiny it hurt me poor eyes. You surely are incredibly rich human who has even three or four coins at once! Perhaps you want to exchange them for some things me offer? Just don't rob me too much, me little stupid goblin, have no idea what stuff is worth... you look honest, you surely pay fair price like I ask and tell if it's too cheap.

Furry guys are strange fellows. Always collecting things and stuff. Not easy to make them share, oh there is noooo profit for little, poor me to be made. They build underground dens that can stretch quite far. Rumour has it the corym have strange tunnels that connect their different networks all over the world.

farewell: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
greet: Psht! Not that loud! Evil lurks everywhere.

reply: My name is Rapanaio from the Royal Tibia Line.
I am the captain of this sailing-ship.

greet: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! I heard you are on a mission for my friend the draccoon!

reply: I am known as Rascalio.
My role here is Ferryman.

farewell: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, may the winds guide your way.
greet: Ah, a customer! Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|!

reply: I am a travelling trader. I don't buy everything, though. And not from everyone, for that matter.
I am Rashid, son of the desert.
Of course, old friend. You can also browse only armor, legs, shields, helmets, boots, weapons, enchanted weapons, jewelry or miscellaneous stuff.
Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.
I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
It's not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.
Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.
Too few customers there, it's not worth the trip.
Um... I don't think so.
I don't like being underground much. I also tend to get lost in these labyrinthine dwarven tunnels, so I rather avoid them.
When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the governor's daughter.
Um... I don't think so.
I like the settlement itself, but I don't set my foot into the jungle. Have you seen the size of these centipedes??
Um... I don't think so.
I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
Um... I don't think so.
Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
It's almost time to journey on.
Kings, queens, emperors and kaliphs... everyone claims to be different and unique, but actually it's the same thing everywhere.

greet: Meep? I mean - hello! Sorry, |PLAYERNAME|... Being a {rat} has kind of grown on me.

reply: Your power of observation is stunning. Yes, I'm a rat.

greet: Be greeted. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
Hello sweetie. If you need general equipment, stuff like that, let me know.

reply: Just between you and me hun, that woman is a witch. Love potions, poison, voodoo dolls to torture your neighbour. You name it, she got it.
Uh! <whispers> There are ... rumours, you know? About bloody rituals and gruesome curses ... better don't talk aloud about such issues.
Kshh!! No talks about ... the magic folk here ... This might draw their attention.
Hard to imagine that this fat man has such a pretty daughter.
Don't mention HIM in my house you fool. You call evil and mayhem upon us.
I am not dealing with food.
I won't say anything bad about such a high-born person. That's why I remain silent hun .
I run this little pawnshop, hun, but I think you knew that already.
What interest could a king have in this little settlement? If a king cares about us, there must be something important behind all this.
Liberty comes, liberty goes, only the bay stays. Hehe.
I sell torches, candelabra, and oil.
That guy is a shrewd trader, sweetie. I bet even I could learn a thing or two from him.
That guy is a shrewd trader, sweetie. I bet even I could learn a thing or two from him.
I have shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, scrolls, watches, some lightsources, and other stuff. Just ask me for a {trade}.
I have shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, scrolls, watches, some lightsources, and other stuff. Just ask me for a {trade}.

I have shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, scrolls, watches, some lightsources, and other stuff. Just ask me for a {trade}.
Mostly, pirates are bad for business. But sometimes, they are good for business.
Sadly the workers have hardly enough money to buy something to eat and to drink. That is bad also for my business.
The quara are the curse of the sea. Everybody that dares to enrage the sea spirits has to fear their vengeance. They come at night to kidnap people who forgot their lucky charms at home ...
Sometimes those evil beings take the most naughty children to raise them as their own underwater.
Ah, there is little in the world that comes close to the taste of rum.
I heard there is a fine bounty on his head. Would be a shame though to lose such a handsome man to the executioner <winks>.
Sugar lets the money flow. We depend heavily on it.
Thais might be a splendid town, but this is of no use to us here. The situation in our town gets worse with every ship full of foreigners that arrives here.
I heard Venore will soon acquire several trade monopolies that will grant them wealth for centuries.

Well, <lowers the voice to a whisper> there are several people around who know this or that about voodoo and not all of them are up to something good. Just buy some lucky charms from that old hag Charlotta to be on the safe side.
A handsome man but a bit too stiff. I think no one has ever had a chance to see him smiling.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. Remember that if you buy vials of oil, there's a deposit of 5 gold on the empty one.

entries.text: Come visit my little pawnshop! General equipment and such. Don't miss it!

provisional

greet: Grr. Intruder!

reply: I'm Rhargu.
I'm the leader of this werehyaena pack.

greet: Hello there, mate. Here for a {trade}? My stock's just been refilled.

reply: Richard. Just Richard. Lost my surname with my past in that storm. <winks>
This lovely island here. Once I didn't have to live off squirrels, it became quite enjoyable. Nasty things though live underground, so take care where you tread and ALWAYS have a rope with you!
<shrugs> Never been, mate. Heard it's kinda cute, though.

You know, I really don't want to poke into someone else's private life. Suffice it to say that everyone has chapters of his life he doesn't want to mention. Judging by Coltrayne's looks, we're looking at a trilogy here.
Old Inigo was the one who found me, actually, and brought me to the outpost. I was half starved by then. He taught me how to make better traps and how to fish... I owe much to Inigo.
Can you believe how old he is? He won't say it, but I wouldn't be surprised if he had been around for loooooong time.
Don't talk to ME about squirrels! <shudders> Had to live off them the first days, when they were the only thing to go into my self-made acorn traps. Nasty.
Don't know what to make of him. Great researcher in all Dawnport matters, though. Always has a quest or two where he needs help, if you're looking for adventuring work.
Quiet little lady, her. Knows her way around the isle, looking for herbs and stuff but mostly spends her time in the temple, helping younglings like you choose a vocation.

You know, on the day that ol' pirate decides to make off with all that gold in the bank, I'm gonna come with him. Should be much more fun landing on a strange island with some gold to spend on booze and babes! <winks>
Tries to act tough, but he's quite a witty and decent bloke who wouldn't hurt a fly. We enjoy a good laugh together in the evenings.
I wouldn't be too surprised if the key had been stolen. As often as everybody left it lying around unattended, something like that was bound to happen sooner or later.

I was a carpenter, back on Main. Wanted my own little shop. Didn't sit with the old man. So I shipped to somewhere else. Terrible storm. Woke up on this island. Had to eat squirrels before the adventurers found me and took me in. End of story.

Only the best quality, I assure you. A rope in need is a friend indeed! Imagine you stumble into a rat hole without a rope - heh, your bones will be gnawed clean before someone finds ya! Now, about that rope - ask me for {equipment} to see my wares. <winks>
Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at {containers}, {food}, {equipment}, or {others}?

entries.text: Don't forget to always have a rope with you! Buy one here, only the best quality!
Don't complain to ME when you fell down a hole without a rope to get you out! You can buy one here now!
Everything an adventurer needs!
A rope is the adventurer's best friend!
Fresh meat! Durable provisions! Ropes and shovels!
Feeling like a bit of treasure-seeking? Buy a shovel or a pick and investigate likely-looking stone piles and cracks!

farewell: HEHEHE! I knew you don't have the stomach.
greet: |PLAYERNAME| HEHEHEHE! Another fool visits the {tower}! Excellent!

reply: This tower, of course, silly one. It holds my {master'}s {treasure}.
This tower, of course, silly one. It holds my {master'}s {treasure}.
His name is none of your business
I am guarding the treasures of the tower. Only those who pass the {test} of the three sigils may pass.
I am known as the riddler. That is all you need to know.
I am the guardian of the paradox tower.
The key of this tower! You will never find it! A malicious plant spirit is guarding it!.
The key of this tower! You will never find it! A malicious plant spirit is guarding it!.
Another one of a few friends of my youth who's still left.
A misguided follower of evil.
I don't like swords in general.
I meet him often at Frodo's. He's a fine fellow, but he always tells me the same stories because he forgets that he already told them to me.
I am his Master of the Hunt as I was his father's Master of the Hunt.
The farmers are fine fellows.
These mages still give me shivers. I remember the first time this Ferumbras guy showed his ugly face here.
I am the Chief Huntsman of Thais.
Hum? No, he never told me anything like that.
My buddy Quentin is getting old, too. Things were different in our youth.
These kids call themselves an army... In the old times we had a REAL army, I tell ya...
These mages still give me shivers. I remember the first time this Ferumbras guy showed his ugly face here.
Druids have their ways with nature, but they would rather cuddle a bear than hunt it.
Can you imagine this youngster handling a guild? Ah, come on.
The farmers are fine fellows.
I hardly know him.
Oh, what a charming young man. He's often here asking me about my youth and the people I met in my life.
Crunor gives and takes. That is his way. As long as we don't hunt more than we need, we are at balance with Crunor.
Ah, I love that hut. I liked it as it was Iwan's hut, I loved it as it was Pridence's hut, and I think I will never stop to love this place.
A master, or better mistress, of the bow. But with her big feet she just chases all game away.
Can you imagine his father was such a fine guy? A shame what his son has become.
So young and so beautiful! She makes even an old man as me... um... feel a bit younger again.
Druids have their ways with nature, but they would rather cuddle a bear than hunt it.
I am his Master of the Hunt as I was his father's Master of the Hunt.
Such guys don't live long. The grandfather of our king had a new jester every season.
Sells a lot of useful stuff, that guy. I remember the days when we were so poor that we could not afford anything the former owner offered.
News? In the woods I learn nothing of importance to the world.
These kids call themselves an army... In the old times we had a REAL army, I tell ya...
Time... it's running that fast when you are as old as me.
I am Robin. Some call me Rob, others Woody.
I have not much use for heavy armor.
I am the Chief Huntsman of Thais.

greet: Hrmpf, I'd say welcome if I felt like lying.

reply: What an irony. I was stranded here for years and now my isle becomes part of an regular shipping route. But so I have the best of both worlds. My solitude and provisions. That's enough for me.
You mean the little guy over there? I call him Lunch. He is my ... uhm friend ... I guess.

You won't believe it, but I found him in a giant fish that I captured. When I cut the beast in pieces, I saw a little goblin cowering inside. ... He did not seem to be a threat and I kind of adopted him. Since I captured the fish for lunch and it was lunchtime I named him Lunch. ... He learnt our language quite fast. Well at least the basics. He never bothered to improve his grammar but I'm no teacher anyway.
I'm Robson Stonespitter, Son of Earth of the Dragoneater fellowship.

It seems there was once a building in the centre of the isle. The ruins are still there. Some of the pillars outside remind me of what I've seen in a bonelord hideout that we've raided when I was younger. ... The rest of the ruins here, though, does not fit into that. Either the isle has been populated by different inhabitants, or by some race that I don't know at all. ... Be it as it may, there has to be something about this isle that attracted inhabitants before me and I wonder what that might be. ... I could not figure it out in all those years though. So I doubt anyone can do that during my lifetime.
I was once a trader but after some years stranded on this remote isle, I felt that I liked that kind of life better and just stayed here even after steamships found that isle.

entries.text: <mumbles>
Just great. Getting stranded on a remote underground isle was not that bad but now I'm becoming a tourist attraction!

farewell: Promise to come back sometime, will ya?
greet: Everyone on this island has gone crazy! Except for me and you, it seems. Let's {trade} like normal people would.

reply: Have you noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to announce: I'm a trader
No, you got it all wrong! I said I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place!
I can help you buy trading stuff with you. Good for me, good for you. It's a win-win!
Have you noticed that I'm actually the only rock on this island with a proper job? Those lazy pebbleheads! I'm proud to announce: I'm a trader

walkaway: Hey! Don't leave me alone with all these lunatics!

greet: Welcome, this is the {Gray Beach temple}, |PLAYERNAME|. Whether you are wounded, poisoned - or wait, don't tell me - yes, this is probably a case of being more emotionally hurt, I will do my best to {heal} you.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

farewell: Goodbye and please bring more gold next time <chuckles>. I mean, it would be nice to see you again.
greet: I welcome thee, |PLAYERNAME|! I suppose you are looking for a trade in fine weapons!

reply: I am Romella and I will be serving you today.
I am Romella and I will be serving you today.
I have many weapons to offer. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
I sell and buy weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
I sell and buy weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
Our warehouse is the main supplier of the local garrison.
It says the amazons are looking for a certain magical weapon in this area.
I wonder how they finance themselves. I bet they are secretly trading in some strange stuff.
Make sure to buy some extra weapons before facing that one.
I heard the amazons are after it.
Don't go exploring without weapons. Especially you'll need a machete.

entries.text: Check out my good and sturdy weapons!

greet: Greetings and nature's blessing, traveller!

reply: I'm here to celebrate life. I will stay with you mortals for a while. I exchange {seeds}, which you might have found on your adventures, for flowerpots with rare seedlings.
You will have to water it regularly, then it will flourish and grow. There are several stages of growth that your plant has to pass ...
With good care and luck, it will grow into the next stage until it finally becomes a fully blooming flower. ...
Of course plants won't grow in the darkness of a depot box. On the other hand, it won't dry out there either ...
So if you know you can't take care of your plant for a longer time, it might be a good idea to store it into your depot box.
Flowers are one of the most beautiful gifts that {Crunor} blessed us with. They are very delicate creatures and must be treated with utmost care.
I'm Rosemarie the {dryad}, and just like my name is linked to flowers, my whole existence is connected to the life of plants.
Dryads are the daughters of {Crunor} and the protectors of {plant} life. Sadly, most of my sisters are quite aggressive on their mission.
The bringer of life and fertility is worshipped by all dryads.
Many dryads consider almost everything that is no {plant} as a threat to plants and the forests ...
Humans that lumber our forests to build their wooden caves and the strange things they use to cross the seas are especially threatening.
I love to stroll around in the jungle. The diversity of plants is fantastic there and even the poisonous spit nettle remains calm if it feels the unconditional love for all plants in your heart.
I prefer to stay outside of towns to enjoy the nature around me.
It has its charm but the more plants I have around me the better I feel.
I prefer to stay outside of towns but this spot here is tolerable.
The elves found the perfect balance between living from the plants and living with the plants. They should be role models for every living being.
I accept every way of life but this of the dwarfs is not mine. Without sunlight, I would shrivel within days like a plant.
For me, the trees in the {jungle} of Tiquanda are the kings. Oh, you mean the Tibian king? I'm not interested in human bureaucracy.
The griffinclaw is the queen among the plants.
Well, how do I look? Beautiful isn't?
You will have to water it regularly, then it will flourish and grow. There are several stages of growth that your plant has to pass ...
With good care and luck, it will grow into the next stage until it finally becomes a fully blooming {flower}. ...
Of course plants won't grow in the darkness of a depot box. On the other hand, it won't dry out there either ...
So if you know you can't take care of your plant for a longer time, it might be a good idea to store it into your depot box.

entries.text: Flowers are one of the most beautiful gifts that Crunor blessed us with.
Celebrate life and nature!

greet: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! How may I assist you today?

reply: I am Rosina.
I am here to help travelers and adventurers who pass through.
I can provide information about the surrounding area and its dangers.
There are many creatures out there. Be prepared before you venture forth.
Always be prepared for the unexpected. Bring enough supplies and stay alert.

greet: Hello, my lad. Sit down, have a drink, why don't you?

reply: Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild, my friend.

Much of your adventuring life will be exploring and hunting monsters on your own. There are many places all over the world that are crowded with fearsome monsters and fascinating treasures. ... More often than not, it will be up to you to decide where and how to get experience and wealth in a way that suits your tastes. Explore the world, but be careful. There are things out there that pose a challenge even to experienced adventurers. ... While you are inexperienced and weak, there is a plethora of creatures that can easily kill you. So never be too bold in unknown territory! ... If you jump down a hole, be prepared to immediately climb up again. When facing enemies of unknown strength, try to fight only one at once. ... Always keep in mind that you need time and resources for your way back and that any enemy corpses you might find, could indicate you might have to face these enemies on your way back. ... Sometimes, missions suiting your experience level might lead you to dangerous, unknown parts of the world, and might require you to join forces with other adventurers. ... From time to time, certain areas of the world are also threatened by dangerous creatures, trying to invade. Usually, this will be felt throughout the world, so everyone is alerted to such an event. ... If you are close to one of these events, you might want to participate. In that case, you will need to work together with other heroes to defeat the enemy invasion. ... It takes large organised groups to reach and defeat the monsters at the remote spots where they appear. ... If you prefer less violent affairs however, there are also several seasonal events which are usually not overly violent in nature, where you can join in. ... Talk to one of the local towncriers now and then to learn what is happening in the world. Most of those events require some form of travelling though, so be prepared to see more of the world!

When you die in Tibia, you will be resurrected in the temple of the city you chose as your home. You can change your home city, and thus the point of your resurrection, in a temple in any city. ... In those temples or sometimes at special places you will find special teleporters that make you an 'inhabitant' of that particular city. That means you will be resurrected there, regardless of where you died in Tibia. ... However, this can mean a long way to travel to the site of your demise, and might strand you in a city without any money. So you'd better make sure to always have cash on your bank account! ... To prevent some of your losses in case of death, you can do another thing as well: you can acquire blessings at certain temples.
What do you wish to know? Is it about death, the blessings, or the vocation promotion?

A promotion is available to premium account adventurers with some basic experience, at level 20. ... A promotion will increase your health and mana regeneration, help you lose less experience and training if you die, and will give you access to additional useful and powerful spells. ... A promotion is available from me or one of the great leaders of the nations for the cost of 20.000 gold. ... If you are prepared for your promotion, let us talk about your advancement.

You become stronger in several ways, some more obvious than others. First of all, there is your equipment. Better equipment means you are harder to kill. ... Equipment can be dropped as loot by killed creatures. Stronger monsters drop better loot of course. You might get equipment as a reward from some missions, which is especially true for the most experienced adventurers. ... You can also buy equipment offered by other players in the market, accessible via the depot. Then there are your skills - when they improve, so does your chance to cope with enemies that you encounter on your travels.

Blessings are something the gods bestow upon us in order to protect us. They are expensive though, and require a lot of costly travel. So it might take a while until blessings are an option for an adventurer. ... In case of death, blessings will reduce the loss of experience. The different blessings are cumulative, and add up with each other. However, blessings are spent once you die, and will have to be renewed again. ... Therefore, blessings are mainly a tool for the experienced adventurer who has a lot to lose when he dies.

You become stronger in several ways, some more obvious than others. First of all, there is your equipment. Better equipment means you are harder to kill. Then there's your skill and experience, and your vocation, for example.
Your vocation is what you chose to be - either a knight, paladin, druid or sorcerer. Each vocation has its own fighting technique and skills.

Creature products come in all forms, colors and tastes. The simplest creature product is likely to be something edible. You want to carry as much food as possible, but it is probably the first thing to get rid of to carry some valuable loot. ... Other products are bought by specific alchemists, trophy hunters or curiosity collectors. Other items might play a role in certain missions, or are useful for obtaining certain items that people value. ... So you can either ask around if certain inhabitants are interested in particular creature products, or try to sell them to other heroes in the market - which you can access via your depot. ... Depots and the market itself is global, so there is no need to check another city, the market is always the same. If you are unsure if an item is worth to be kept, keep it in your depot until you learned about its worth.

If you have a premium account and were blessed by the gods, you can also use the training statues for some meditative combat training. This means your skills are trained while your character is logged out.

The great leaders of the world who grant a promotion to adventurers are King Tibianus in Thais, Queen Eloise of Carlin, the emperors Kruzak of Kazordoon and Rehal of Beregar, ... and on behalf of the pharaoh himself, the grand vizier Ishebad in Ankrahmun. ... Don't forget that you can get your promotion also from me if you don't like those royal ceremonies.

For example, fighting is something you can - and will - do a lot of in your adventuring life, either for a mission or on your own, in order to become stronger. Also, fighting will get you different kinds of loot.

You may talk to Charos upstairs to change your destination city at our teleporters. But you have to know that this service is only available to new heroes, and only for a given number of times. ... Charos will tell you how often you can change your destination city.

Another way to become more powerful is to learn new spells, if your vocation uses spells. You can learn spells at certain places in each city - usually the local guild of your vocation, but that may vary from city to city.

Be careful not to die, as you lose skill points with each death! Skills increase by using them. So when you fight a creature, you will always grow a little more skilled with the weapon or magic skill that you use. ... Then there is your experience, of course. The more experience you have gained, the more life force and mana you have at your disposal. As you probably already know, you get experience through fighting things, and some missions. ... Premium accounts have two additional possibilities, as they can also use training statues and get promotions.

Death is always a threat. When you are resurrected in the temple, you will find you might have lost quite a lot of your equipment. You might want to try to retrieve the more valuable stuff from your dead body. ... Your dead body will take a while before it decays, and can be looted - by anyone. But before you run off into danger, remember: You will need a ROPE or a shovel to reach certain spots. ... It is likely that you lost your rope when you died, so you might need to replace it. For this purpose, it might be a good idea to have stashed some basic equipment in your depot. ... This will spare you valuable time when you hurry back to your corpse. Remember that each city has its own depot! ... Another thing that you can do to prevent some of your losses in case of death, is to acquire blessings at certain temples.

What you stash in the depot of one city, is global, thus can be retrieved at a depot in another city. Your bank account as well as your inbox are global, and can be accessed from every city. ... Whenever you deposit or withdraw money anywhere in the world, it will be the same money balance that is changed. ... Also, through your depot, you can access the market to trade items with other players, to buy or sell items there. ... To prevent some of your losses in case of death, you might also want to acquire blessings at certain temples.
Sorry but this is a matter I'm not prepared to discuss ... yet.
It is said that he lives on a small island near the city of Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.

The simplest loot is probably junk, but other stuff dropped by slain monsters might be worth something to one of the inhabitants; or you can sell it to some vendors. Dropped creature products often are not that heavy, so they might be worth keeping. ... Check if any dropped weapons or armor are better than what you have. Even if they're not, it might be worth keeping them to sell them to a weapon or armor vendor. ... Provided you have the capacity to carry it, that is! But don't become overconfident and forget about death! If you die, you lose part of what you carry, so you might want to stash some spare equipment at the depot.
We always need a hand charting Tibia. Our map of the world can't be detailed enough. Talk to me if you're interested or if you already have a map and lost it.
Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild, my friend.

entries.text: <sigh> The world has grown complicated since my youth.

greet: Hunter's greeting! I assume you want something from me since you came all the way out here on your own. This is a dangerous place to be, I doubt that all my men will accept strangers like I do. You don't seem to have any problems with that, though.
Oh, a customer. Hello |PLAYERNAME|. If you'd like to see my wonderful self-tailored clothes, ask me for a {trade}.
send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares.

reply: Oh, the sleigh is magical, of course. It was made by some djinn that owed good old Santa a favour.

The goblins of clan Grynch have made it a habit to steal presents in the cities and even from Santa's sleigh. If you should find any, please return them to me and I will reward you with a token. You can collect tokens and trade them for a nice gift.

The goblins of clan Grynch are a constant nuisance. They steal everything that is not nailed to the ground, and if possible even that. ... They do not shrink away from stealing presents from little children. If you should manage to get your hands on the stolen presents Santa will gladly return them to their rightful owners.

The goblins of clan Grynch are a constant nuisance. They steal everything that is not nailed to the ground, and if possible even that. ... They do not shrink away from stealing presents from little children. If you should manage to get your hands on the stolen presents Santa will gladly return them to their rightful owners.
The entrance to the bakery is right behind my hut.

They are no ordinary deer, but a rare magical breed. They are fun and nice, you know. The ugly thing about them is that they prefer a stew made of old, worn boots of haste. Guess that keeps them fast and flying. But what a foul stench!!

If you have any tokens you'd like to turn in, just tell me to turn in the tokens. ... For 1 token you will get a gingerbread man or christmas cookie tray. For 10 tokens I will give you a recipe so you can make your own gingerbread men in the christmas bakery. ... For 25 tokens I will give you a jewel box, while you can trade 50 tokens for a hat, just like the one Santa has. ... 75 tokens are enough for a fluffy santa backpack or a snowflake tapestry, and for 100 tokens you will get a santa doll. I trade 150 tokens for a snowman doll or a snow globe. ... 250 tokens are enough for a frazzlemaw santa, a leaf golem santa, a maxxen santa, a ferumbras' teddy santa, an orclops santa, a santa music box, a santa fox, a nightmare beast santa ... a santa leech, a raccoon santa and finally 500 tokens for a santa teddy.

greet: Human! The ancient spirits are in unrest.

reply: I am known as S'Zallar M'Andar.
My role here is quest giver.
The dragon cemetery is a place most sacred. Its bones are heavy with ancient breath, and we, the scaled children, dare not tread upon that hallowed ground. ...
To us, its silence is forbidden. Only echoes of wrath linger there. ...
Name is Saih, I greet you, pilgrim.

The valley has been our home as it has been the home of our ancestors who were separated from the birth-place. It is a place worth fighting for. As is the legacy of the Merudri and everything we achieved.
We are Merudri, this valley has been our sanctuary for centuries and is the only thing left from our true ancestral home.

greet: Welcome to my shop, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|! I {trade} with weapons and armor.

reply: I am the blacksmith. If you need weapons or armor - just ask me for a trade.
It is rumoured to be a weapon beyond mortal craftsmanship.
A threat for mankind! Buy weapons to be ready to face him.
The king supports Tibia's economy a lot.
Yes, I know that guy. He's a good customer at Frodo's. We don't really chat though.
He is a monk of some kind!
Below our city are the sewers and I heard about a passage to the deeper dungeons.
Yeah, these awful beasts. They live in the forests near the city and in the sewers and dungeons.
A warrior who is a joy for Banor.
A warrior who is a joy for Banor.
Don't ask me. I have never been there.
Sandals? I don't sell those. I only wear some myself, they're in the chest beside my bed. But they're not for sale, of course!
Sorcerers seldom need my skills.
A fine warrior.
His guild relies heavily on my wares.
The McRonalds are the local farmers, aren't they?
I never visited his ... cave or whatever it's called.
Oswald isn't one of the most liked people in this city.
I don't like crowded places like his bar.
I just know some rumours that he is a follower of evil.
Oh, I hardly know her.
Below our city are the sewers and I heard about a passage to the deeper dungeons.
Uhm! <blushes>
My name is Samuel, but you can call me Sam.
The king supports Tibia's economy a lot.
He is funny now and then.
He can tell a tale or two about his adventures with baxter in their younger days.
I supply the army with weapons and armor.
I know nothing of interest.
I was named after my grandfather.

entries.text: Hello there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!

farewell: Praise the gods, I bid you farewell.
greet: Hm. Greetings.

farewell: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|, please come back soon.
greet: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, welcome to the fluid and potion {shop} of Edron.

reply: I sell potions and fluids. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. By the way, if you'd like to join our bonus system for depositing flasks and vial, you have to tell me about that {deposit}.

entries.text: Great spirit potions as well as health and mana potions in different sizes!
If you need alchemical fluids like slime and blood, get them here.

walkaway: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|, please come back soon.

greet: ...er... hello? Yes...? Well, if... if you have any questions - I am not even here.

reply: I AM THE... I mean... I am - what is a mage, if he is not {mad}? If he isn't... raging? I am... I am just sane. A sane mage.
I am not mad... I- YES, that's the whole problem, isn't it? What's going on, what's happening to me? I don't even know anymore.
Yes, well... I'm taking a break. It will take some time. I don't know how long I just... I want to get away from all this for some time, that's it.
Slime is my mission. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right now at least.
Slime is my mission. Is there anything more important? There isn't. To me. Right now at least.
You want to help me? HELP me? You? Who... who are you anyway? Ah nevermind.

entries.text: Hm? What is the meaning of all this?
What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... not?
Evil little beasts... I hope someone helps me fight them.
Nasty creepy crawlies!
Hey! You over there, could you help me with a little quest? Just say 'hi' or 'hello' to talk to me!
Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'hello' or 'hi'!

walkaway: Good bye traveller, and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.

farewell: May the Moon Goddess light your path.
greet: Greetings, traveller. May the Moon Goddess bless you.

reply: I am Saraki, maharani of Moonfall.
I rule Moonfall and I watch over the peace of my people.
Moonfall is where the goddess touched the world. We have guarded this place ever since.
The Moon Goddess fell upon this island long ago, and the stars themselves descended to carry her home.
Our astronomer. She sleeps by day and argues with the sky by night.
She keeps the potion shop here in Moonfall and knows the yukti better than anyone.
Our magic. Ask Sundara about it, she will explain it far better than I could.

walkaway: May the Moon Goddess light your path.

greet: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.

entries.text: General equipment and all sorts of goods. Visit my store!

reply: My name is Scott.
It's a peaceful island. Cold and lonesome but I like it.
I'm the keeper of the inn. You can buy food here.
Oh, I'm happy to live in this world full of thrilling things.
It is said that there are some secrets to discover around the mage's castle.
Sometimes I travel to Carlin and visit the market.
It's a city in the south-west of Tibia.
She is a strong and wise leader. We owe her protection from evil monsters.

A sailor from Carlin told me that the natives of the Ice Islands pray to different gods. I think 'Chyll' is one of them or was that the name of the northern winds?? Well, doesn't matter! Primitives! ... The only green fish I know is the one you can buy at Permaret in Edron as a 'special offer' and that would be your last meal. Trust me! ... I mean there are barbarians and barbarians, some are good, the others not. One call themselves 'Norsir' the others 'Raiders', but actually they are all the same. ... It seems that this was the reason why nobody has discovered the Ice Islands before. Something must have happened because at a moment's notice they disappeared. ... The wolves and bears protect them and tear their foes into pieces if they order them to. If you ask me, this is just gossip. ... That must be the reason why the Carlin traders are so interested in getting there. They sense gold in selling wood. ... He was writing strange things about suspicious inhabitants and something about a test to become one of them. It was very hard to read the letter, I think he was drunk as hell when he wrote it. ... I heard that they dig for valuable ore which was found in an old mine. I wonder why nobody of them has returned yet. Travellers told me that they recently moved into the caverns beneath the island. There, they are growing fresh grass and even flowers! How is that possible in a frozen cave? Some kind of magic has to be involved. ... I'm just not sure whether it is of the benevolent or the malicious kind.

entries.text: Hey there, adventurer! Need a little rest in my inn? Have some food!

greet: |PLAYERNAME|. I have been watching your fate for quite some time. It's about time you came here. Do you seek to enter the riven island of Quirefang or travel back from where you came?

reply: We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Ab'dendriel?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Edron?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Venore?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Darashia?
My name is Scrutinon. However, there are not many people calling my name nowadays. Not many captains even dare to land on this island. It is too close to {Quirefang}. ...
Most of them do not know this island by that name. Some call it Demon Horn, others the Dragon's Tooth or the Gray Beach as none of them ever came closer than a fair distance. ...

There are drifts and storms surrounding that place that are far too dangerous to navigate through even for the most versed captains. They often sail not closer than to this island here and drop off whoever dares to explore near this dreaded coast.

greet: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.

reply: We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Liberty Bay for |TRAVELCOST|?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you want to sail Meriana for |TRAVELCOST|?
Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Meriana}?
I am the captain of this ship.
I am the captain of this ship.

Would you like to learn {brutal strike} magic spell for 1000 gold?
Would you like to learn {cure poison} magic spell for 150 gold?
Would you like to learn {great light} magic spell for 500 gold?
Would you like to learn {find person} magic spell for 80 gold?
Would you like to learn {magic rope} magic spell for 200 gold?
Would you like to learn {light healing} magic spell for free?

Would you like to learn {haste} magic spell for 600 gold?
Would you like to learn {light} magic spell for free?
In this category I have '{Light healing}', '{Wound cleansing}', and '{Cure poison}'.
In this category I have '{Find person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', '{Great Light}', and '{Haste}'.
In this category I have '{Brutal strike}' for knights.
In this category I have '{Conjure Arrow}' for paladins.
I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells}, {conjure spells} and {attack spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
I am Ser Tybald. <bows courteously>.
I'm just an adventurer looking for action. Learn from the best! Just ask me about knight and paladin {spells}.

From afar, the island glowed at midnight as if dawn was at hand. A fierce magical light, beckoning, calling out, promising power past redemption - but I am sure {Garamond} has a better idea as to the exact nature of that magical power.
He's a mentor to all young adventurers. If you have a question as to what you should or could do, and how this world works, talk to Inigo, he will be happy to help.
Now there is someone who has had his share of grief. No wonder he came to {Dawnport} to assist raising new heroes for the {Tibian} lands.
Is that old man still teaching magic spells?
We know each other from old, yes. Will we talk about it? No.
That old pirate has settled down now it seems.
He's quite a good cook, which helps improve the mood on bad days. He's a carpenter by trade. Did a good job reinforcing this outpost, too.
It used to be a kind of title in other times, but it serves nicely as a first name here.
Each vocation has their own unique spells to enhance their fighting or defense, which none of the other vocations can use, and which you can only learn at a spell trainer of your vocation.
Most of the major cities are on the Tibian mainland, such as the rich merchant city of Venore, for example. You will find spell teachers for your vocation in almost every major city.

Tibia is the world we live in. Rookgaard is not far off from the Tibian {mainland}, though it's a tricky passage with contrary winds. On the mainland, you will find more adventure, mystery and monsters and can prove yourself a hero or villain.

What a beautiful lady. Do you know the Lay of the White Lady Illadria? ... 'Calm and slender like a birch, soft and white like snow, yet strong and warm like the sun she is.' Well, it fits perfectly. I am her sworn protector.
Ah, still so young and naive about the gods and demons... Still, I envy him his unspoilt beliefs. If I could turn back time... but never mind my ramblings.
Mr Morris has much on his mind and may have been somewhat distracted with regard to that key. He probably just misplaced it, somewhere on top of all those archeological findings he stores.

greet: Welcome to my fruit and vegetable store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you'd like to see my wares.
The. Slime. Has. Entered. Our. Master. Has. Left! We. Must. Help.

reply: Our. Master. Is. Gone. You. Can. Not. Visit. Him! We. Stand. {Sentry}!
{Master}. Conducted. Experiments. Great. Problems. You. Must. Go!

entries.text: Heed. Your. Will. We. Will.
Intruder. Intrude. Must. Explain.
Ssssttttoooopppp.

reply: Do you have a suitable present box for me?
This is an island with {vocation} teachers. You can learn all about the different vocations there once you are level 8.
It's |TIME|, so you are late. Hurry!
My name is Seymour, but for you I am 'Sir' Seymour.
At least you know how to address a man of my importance.
I'm the master of this fine {academy}, giving {lessons} to my students.
Oh, which lesson did you want to attend again? Was it {Rookgaard}, {fighting}, {equipment}, {citizens}, the {academy} or the {oracle}?
In a bank you can deposit your earned gold coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.
Yes, depositing your money will keep it safe, so it is a good idea to store it in the bank. Of course, you can always withdraw it again.
Well, the {king} doesn't send troops anymore, the {academy} is dreadfully low on money, and the end of the world is pretty nigh. Apart from that I'm reasonably fine, I suppose.
Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any non-player character and I will tell you something about him or her.
Merchants buy and sell goods. Just ask them for a {trade} to see what they offer or buy from you.
Trolls are quite nasty monsters which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!
The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {monsters} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.
There are four vocations: {knights}, {paladins}, {sorcerers} and {druids}. You can choose your vocation once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
Sorcerers are talented elemental magicians. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
Knights are strong melee fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
Druids are nature magic users and great healers. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
Paladins are swift distance fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the north-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.
The world of Tibia is very large with tons of places to explore. Vast deserts, Caribbean islands, deep jungles, green meadows and jagged mountains await you!
The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
Your current health is shown by the red bar on the right side. {Death} awaits you if it goes down to zero.
Dying in Tibia is painful, so try to avoid it. You will lose part of your {experience} points and also equipment. Make sure your {health} always stays up!
You gain experience when fighting {monsters}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.
Good monsters to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.
One entrance to the sewers is south of this {academy}. Look for a sewer grate, then use it to climb down.
The academy is the building you are standing in. We have a {library}, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}.
There are many books in the bookcases around you, unless some naughty kids stole them again. Read them for more and detailed information.
Don't go hunting without proper equipment. You need at least a suitable {weapon}, {armor}, {shield}, {rope} and {shovel}. A {torch} is also good as well as {legs}, a {helmet} and {shoes}.
Make money by killing {monsters} and picking up their {loot}. You can sell many of the things they carry.
Once a monster is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other items which you can sell to {merchants}.
You can even sell some corpses! For example, you can sell fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also buys other dead creatures, just ask him for a {trade}.
You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Buy one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large enough to enter.
You should not descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {monsters}.
A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can buy them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
The starter armor, a coat, does not protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and buy a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either buy it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
I fear you have to buy your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.
Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either buy them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can buy them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong enough, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.
Many monsters, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also buy food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.
Paying for your Tibia account will turn it into a premium account. This means access to more areas and functions of the game as well as other neat features.
Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Not that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...
Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can buy them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.
Some monsters poison you. To heal poison, use an antidote potion on yourself. Buy them at {Lily}'s store.
Rookgaard is the name of this {village} as well as of the whole {island}. It belongs to the kingdom of {Thais}, in our world which is called {Tibia}.
The island is separated into a {premium} side and a non-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other players.
The city of Thais is reigned by King Tibianus. Of course, there are many other cities but you will learn about them later.
The most important places in this village are the {temple}, the different {shops}, the {academy} and the {bridges}.
There is a bridge to the north and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.
You can leave for mainland once you are level 8. To do so talk to the {oracle}.
You have to fight {monsters} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {health}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.
The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right now though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.
Once you gained enough experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {health} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.
The farms are west of here. You can buy and sell {food} there which you need to regain {health}.
I personally don't have anything to trade, but you can ask {merchants} for a trade. That will open a window where you can see their offers and the things they buy from you.
Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
Obi sells and buys {weapons}. You can find his shop south of the academy.
Norma has recently opened a bar here meaning she sells drinks and snacks. Nothing of importance to you, young student.
Oh, let's not talk about Loui.
A fine and helpful man. Without him, many new adventurers would be quite clueless.
This is Tom the tanner's mother. Other than that, I don't think she is of importance.
Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village. He sells useful stuff such as {ropes}.
A traveller from the {main} continent. I wonder what brought her here. No one comes here of his own free will.
Billy is {Willie}'s cousin, but he has his farm on the {premium} side of the village.
Willie is a fine farmer, although he is short-tempered. He sells and buys {food}.
A humble monk living in the {temple} south of here. He can heal you if you are wounded or poisoned.
Dixi sells and buys {armors}, {shields}, {helmets} and {legs}. You can find her shop south of the academy, just go up the stairs in {Obi}'s shop.
A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He sells small health {potions} just like {Lily}.
Lee'Delle's shop is in the western part of town, on the {premium} side. She sells everything cheaper.
In the southern part of town, Lily sells {potions} which might come in handy once you are deep in a dungeon and need {health}.
The oracle is a mysterious being just upstairs. It will bring you to the {Island of Destiny} to choose your {vocation} once you are level 8.
Yes, Paulie is very important. He is the local {bank} clerk.
Sir Seymour, yes, that's me.
Tom the tanner buys fresh {corpses}, minotaur leather and paws. Always good to make some {money} if you can carry the corpses there fast enough.
He's the guard on the north {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {monster} locations. Just ask him about monsters!
He's the guard on the west {bridge} and a great fighter. He can show you {monster} locations. Just ask him about monsters!

Get some training in the academy!

Gain some knowledge in the academy!

walkaway: Good bye! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!

entries.text: Fine elven armor and weapons. Have a look.
Looking for protective spells for druids? I can teach you.

greet: Greetings, two-leg.

reply: Sharai.
I watch this stretch of coast. Lately it has been giving me plenty to watch.
An asura complex, drowned centuries ago. The sea took it slowly, wall by wall.
They claim the place now. Not all of them agree on what to do with it, which is the only good news.
They learned to live with the moon's darker face. If anyone can seal that shard, it is them.

I can tell you about the requirements for a transfer, and about what happens to your skills, quests, money and items. ... I can also check if you fulfil the requirements. And I can then teleport you to the departure platform.
Yes, you will also keep the items in your inventory.

Character World Transfer means that you will leave this world and move to a new one to live there. If you need detailed information just ask me. I can also check if you're ready and if you are, I can teleport you to the transfer platform.
Before I can teleport you to the transport platform, I must check if you meet the requirements for a Character World Transfer first.

This is how the small island that used to be here was called. We still run a Character World Transfer from the remains of it, here. ... It was nothing much, just a speck in the ocean. But after a sea quake, most of it was swallowed by the sea. But it is still a magical place where we can send you to another world, if you wish.
I'm sorry, but I'm not qualified to divorce you. You will have to go to a priest on the Mainland for that.
What!? Are you sure that's him? No, it... it cannot be. I mean, how could this happen? ... I guess he wanted to look for sunken treasures on Travora. After all, he is - was - a dwarf. <sigh> How sad.

<sigh> He used to be my only company on Travora. But when the island sank, he became quite moody. ... I thought maybe he wanted to start a new life on the mainland. He left one night, suddenly. He didn't even say goodbye.
I recommend depositing all of your gold in the bank. You will keep ALL of the money on your bank account on the new world.

All your items in your inventory, your inbox and your depot will be transferred. ... I recommend checking all the items you want to keep and to sell the rest; and deposit your money on your bank account. Or you could give some to friends who stay here! ... I can check if you meet all necessary requirements for a transfer.
No worries there. You keep all your items that are in your inventory, inbox and depot.
You keep all items that are in your inbox when transferring to another world.
You will keep all of your skills and levels as they currently are. Easy as that.
What!? Are you sure that's him? No, it... it cannot be. I mean, how could this happen? ... I guess he wanted to look for sunken treasures on Travora. After all, he is - was - a dwarf. <sigh> How sad.
No, there's no bank here anymore. There used to be one on the island, but there's no need for one these days. You need to visit one of the major cities if you require a bank.
My name is Sharon.
<sigh> Time seems to stand still, here.
I help you to prepare your Character World Transfer by giving you all kind of information.

reply: No news are good news.
HAIL TO QUEEN ELOISE!
HAIL TO QUEEN ELOISE!
Just fine.
Would you like to buy the general key to the town?
Yeah, I bet you'd like to do that! HO, HO, HO!
If they make trouble, I'll put them behind bars like all others.
If they make trouble, I'll put them behind bars like all others.
The Bonecrusher family is ideally suited for military jobs.
The Bonecrusher family is ideally suited for military jobs.
If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.

If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
The castle is one of the safest places in Carlin.
Our people are fine and peaceful.
I bet they spy on us... not my business, however.
I scared this bigmouth so much that he left the town by night. HO, HO, HO!
The city is is a peaceful place, and it's up to me to keep it this way.
He is the guy responsible to keep the sewers working. Someone has to do such kind of jobs. I can't handle all the garbage of the city myself.
Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.
Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.
Cornelia is one of our local smiths. When you look for armor, look for Cornelia.
Cornelia is one of our local smiths. When you look for armor, look for Cornelia.
She has the sharpest eye in the region, I'd say.
Her peacefulness is sometimes near stupidity.
I worship Banor of course.
For me, he's the god of justice.
His cult is forbidden in our town.
Wouldn't wonder if some males worship him secretly. HO, HO, HO!
I deal more with the human mosters, you know? HO, HO, HO!
Would certainly make a good butterknife. HO, HO, HO!
The only thing that rebels here now and then is the stomach of a male after trying to make illegal alcohol. HO, HO, HO!
For obvious reasons it's forbidden in our city.

reply: He is an impressive warrior as far as I can tell.
King Tibianus granted us this farm to earn a living.
Oh, he's a nice old man. He often comes and buys our goods. I haven't seen him since a while though.
My husband Donald is busy on the fields almost all night and day.
The weather is the best friend and the worst enemy of a farmer.
I don't know for sure. The miller claims that his mill is threatened by some monsters sometimes.
What a nice person he is.
The druids helped us by placing a blessing on our fields.
We a mere peasants and don't know much about the guild leaders.
We a mere peasants and don't know much about the guild leaders.

He is a friend of my husband.
She is sooo charming. I can't believe she is not married yet! Have you met her?
I am Sherry McRonald.
Sorry, I don't have a watch.

The city needs our crops.

reply: Hundreds of years my master's castle stood on the top of this mountain. Now there is a volcano.
I can still feel the magical energy in the volcano.
If you are one of his followers, you need not ask about him, for you will know. And if you aren't, you are not worthy anyway!
The castle was destroyed when my master tried to summon a nameless creature. All that is left is this volcano.
Here lies my master. Only his closest followers may enter.
I am Skjaar the Mage, master of all spells.
To those who have lived for a thousand years time holds no more terror.
