greet: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.

reply: I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will not rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.

I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will not rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.

I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will not rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.
The sea of light is what I call the endless arrangement of shiny stars in the night sky. If we fail to complete the {magic device}, science will probably never uncover its secrets.

I found the cause of the initial failure. A rare component, a mirror crystal was used to store magical energy. Miscalculations within the construction damaged this fragile power source. The unleashed energy must have been devastating.

The people of Edron were digging there for minerals and gold. It seemed all that work was of no avail when they finally hit the motherlode. Gems, rare crystals and... water. So much that it flooded the whole system. And not a single soul escaped.

I heard rumours of a fabled creature whose traces were found on an island near Carlin. It lives solely to collect all kinds of rare gems, crystals and minerals. Offering an item it does not already own, reportedly allows passage into its lair.

entries.text: Precisely.
So my initial calculations had been correct!
Looks like I have to find another way then.
Hm, I need to recapitulate my equipment...

greet: Can you hear that...!? Oh, hello there. Have you come seeking wisdom...? A story perhaps?

reply: I do not have a proper name, for I am a child of nature. I was given the gift to communicate with ancient ethereal beings; that is where my name comes from: the 'Spirit Speaker'.
Job? I am a spirit speaker and a traveller of these lands. I discover its mysteries and learn about its past... our past. ...
Now you may be wondering what I do with all that knowledge and the answer is simple - I share it.

Here's a story worth telling, one that I'm sure will get your attention. There is a legend that says that in the small island of Rookgaard, where new adventurers start their journeys, there is a sword. ...
Guarded by the most powerful of minotaur sorcerers! The sword is known as the Sword of Fury. Is the legend true? Who knows.

greet: Ahoyyy there, you might be just who I'm looking for. I need some help on an adventure ...

reply: Sterling's the name, adventuring's the game!
I'm an old adventurer who's seen his fair share of the seas.
The closest island, where those pesky pirates crash landed.
They've been wreaking havoc and capturing wild turtles. Someone has to stop them!
A dear friend of mine. You'll find her in the cave to the south of Aragonia.
My trusty turtle! Sit on her back and she'll carry you to Aragonia.

greet: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! Good you're showing up.

reply: I can't reveal much to you right now as time is of the essence. I can tell you though that the glooth plant and the whole town are in danger and we have to act to stop a {madman} and his schemes.
I defeated him there in the past. It has been abandoned for many {years}, but I suspected him to return from the dead eventually, as he has done so often before.
The creature is powerful but not very clever. It seems it can be easily {enraged} and then it would likely let slip all caution and would relentlessly attack without regard for its safety.
I used the time to prepare. You'll find my talking tubes all the {way} to his lair, and I can provide you with vital information about the things ahead.

greet: A gryphon rider! What a rare honour!

reply: I am known as Taya.
My role here is Cleric.
Ah, the pleasures to be an oracle!
Praised be Suon, the Benevolent Sun.

greet: Hello. I'm so glad someone has found me. Did you meet THEM?!
Hello! Sorry I'm a bit busy.
Where .. am I?

entries.text: What .. happened?

greet: Greetings, friend. Good you are showing up.
Hey there, you are surely interested in helping the Rathleton city guard, right? Right - especially now since the dreaded minotaurs gain more ground every day.
Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

farewell: Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
greet: How could you sneak up on me like this? I thought you were one of THEM! Well, since you are not, what brings you to this wilderness?
walkaway: Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.

greet: Hi! You look like someone on a {mission}.

reply: Me put name away name long ago. Now only blind prophet of ape people are.
Me is who in dreams speak to holy banana. Me divine the will of banana.
Me {prophet} and {guardian} is.
Me is who in dreams speak to holy banana. Me divine the will of banana.
Me guard the forbidden land behind the great palisade. If any want to enter, he must ask me for transport.
Me guard the forbidden land behind the great palisade. If any want to enter, he must ask me for transport.
Good ape he is. Has to work hard to make other apes listen but you helped a lot.

Our holy ancestor he is. Big as mountain. Lizards say they built palisade to keep him but we not believe ... We think Bong palisade built to have peace from pesky lizards. We respect peace of Bong, keep people away from forbidden land.
The lizards evil and vengeful are. Ape people on guard must be.
Our people a lot to learn have. One day we might live in peace with you hairless apes, who knows.
Me not know. Me seldom have visions of not banana related objects.
Hairless apes strange people are.

greet: Welcome to my little realm.
Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|... mortal.

entries.text: Let me mourn in peace.

greet: Graaaaww!

reply: I am known as The Dentist.
My role here is arena visitor.

farewell: Good bye. May the gods watch over your path.
greet: Be greeted, visitor.
Hello, my sparring buddy. We should have another fight sometimes. I think you may have earned a little reward.

reply: Times have changed <sigh>. In the past dragons were feared and respected. Only the {demons} rivalled our notoriety.
Those upstarts! I wonder why would anyone care about them. They lack our style. For them it is all about brute force and showing-off.
Breathing fire is an art! Instead of setting everything on fire, you exhale a cone of fire to give a worthy opponent a chance to avoid it.
Your lives are so short and meaningless and yet you are here! And as a race you even have your own history and remember things with the help of {books}, which amazes me.
I like the idea of books so much that I acquired a human servant to record my memoirs. You find a copy somewhere in my lair.
Lava is only fun as long as it doesn't harden - then it turns into an annoyance.

greet: What brings you here this time, do you want to {craft} weapon in the forge?

entries.text: I'll be doing my job, same as ever. Just lay out your arms.
I knew you'd be back. Lay out your arms. Let's get to smithing.
Ah, You, is it? I... didn't notice you there.

greet: Greetings, dear guest. If you are interested in paperware such as books or scrolls, ask me for a trade.

entries.text: I really have to find this scroll. Where did I put it?
Too much dust here. I should tidy up on occasion.
Someone opened the Grimoire of Flames without permission. Egregious!

greet: Ah, a customer! Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! I buy all kinds of loot, would you like a {trade}? I can also show you my {shop options}.
send_trade: Ah, a customer! Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! I buy all kinds of loot, would you look at <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

farewell: COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!
walkaway: COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!

reply: I am Charkahn the Slayer! The immortal father of the {orcs} and master of this {hive}.
The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
I can sense the presence and the feelings of my underlings and {minions}. I embrace the rage of the horde.
The orcish horde of this hive is under my control. I sense their emotions and their needs and provide them with the leadership they need to focus their hate and rage
Hate and rage are the true blessings of Blog, since they are powerful weapons. They give the hive strength. I provide them with direction and focus.
The Raging One blessed us with his burning hate. We are truly his children and therefore {divine}.
To conquer, to destroy and to dominate. Orcs are born to rule the {world}.
One day I will rule the world, even when turned into a {slime}.
Pah! Don't mock me, mortal! This shape is a curse which the evil {djinn} bestowed upon me!
This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted {lamp}, and he {cheated} me!
Because I freed him he granted me three wishes. He was true to his word in the first two {wishes}.
He built this fortress over Uldrek's grave within a single night. Also, he granted me my second wish and gave me immortality. Test it and try to kill me if you want. Har Har!

I wished to father more healthy and fertile children as any orc has ever done. But the djinn cheated me and made me a slime! Then he laughed at me and left for his abandoned fortress in the {Deathwish} Mountains.

His ancient fortress on Darama was deserted as the evil Djinn fled this world after his imprisonment. Now the time has come for the evil Djinns to return to their master although this will certainly awaken the {good Djinn} too.
I will not share anything more about that topic with you {paleskins}.
You are as ugly as maggots, although not quite as as tasty.

greet: Be greeted, dear visitor. Come and {stay} ... a while.

reply: It's my curse to be the eternal {guardian} of this ancient {place}.
I'm the {guardian} of the {SEVENTH} and final seal. The seal to open the last door before ... but perhaps it's better to see it with your own eyes.
It served as a temple, a source of power and ... as a sender for an ancient {race} which lived a long time ago and has long been forgotten.
The race that built this edifice came to this place from the stars. They ran from an enemy even more horrible than themselves. But they carried the {seed} of their own destruction in them.
This ancient race was annihilated by its own doings, that's all I know. Aeons have passed since then, but the sheer presence of this {complex} is still defiling and desecrating this area.

Its constructors were too strange for you or even me to understand. We don't know what this ... thing they built was supposed to be good for. I feel a constant twisting and binding of souls, though, that is probably only a side-effect.
The place you know as the Ghostlands had a different name once ... and many names after. Too many to remember them all.
They are my maidens. They give me comfort in my eternal watch over the last seal.
It hurts me to even think about my mortal past. Its long lost and forgotten. So don't ask me about it!
This ancient race was annihilated by its own doings, that's all I know. Aeons have passed since then, but the sheer presence of this complex is still defiling and desecrating this area.
If you have passed the first six seals and entered the blue fires leading to the seals' chambers, you are ready to receive my kiss ... It will open the last seal. Do you think you are ready?

entries.text: Uhhhhhh....

walkaway: Yes, flee from death. But know it shall be always one step behind you.

greet: <he glares at you from empty eye sockets. Yet perhaps he might offer you a passage.>

reply: <The oarsman's bony fingers tighten on the oar with his other hand outstretched.>
<Do you want to pay the oarsman 500 gold for a passage? Yes or no?>

reply: I am known as Theodora.
My role here is anniversary reward exchange contact.

greet: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage} back, I can help you.

reply: Then not
Do you seek a ride to Kazordoon for |TRAVELCOST|?
Then not
Do you seek a ride to Cormaya for |TRAVELCOST|?
Then not
Would you like to travel to Gnomprona for |TRAVELCOST|?
Do you want me take you to {Cormaya}, {Kazordoon} or {Gnomprona}?

entries.text: Ask me for a passage...

farewell: Go bother someone else. I have no patience for spies.
greet: Go bother someone else. I have no patience for spies.

entries.text: This place is rotten.

walkaway: Go bother someone else. I have no patience for spies.

greet: Thank you for finding me! I was sure you would be able to save me. But this was really a terrible experience!

reply: I am known as Thundergiant (NPC).
My role here is quest contact.

farewell: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. May the gods be with you to guard and guide you, my child!
greet: Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!

reply: I am a priest of the great pantheon.
The teachings of Crunor tell us to honor life and not to harm it.
It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.
It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.
My name is Tibra. Your soul tells me that you are |PLAYERNAME|.
Queen Eloise is wise to listen to the proposals of the druidic followers of Crunor.
The grace of the gods must be earned, it cannot be bought!
The world of Tibia is the creation of the gods.
Now, it is |TIME|.
There's something strange in its neighbourhood. But whom we gonna call for help if not the gods?
Remind: Not everything you call monster is evil to the core!
The mythical blade was hidden in ancient times. Its said that powerful wards protect it.
The fallen one should be mourned, not feared.
Only a man can fall as low as he did. His soul rotted away already.
The gods of good guard us and guide us, the gods of evil want to destroy us and steal our souls!
The gods we call the good ones are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
Fardos is the creator. The great obsever. He is our caretaker.
Uman is the positive aspect of magic. He brings us the secrets of the arcane arts.
Air is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
Fire is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
Sula is the essence of the elemental power of water.
Suon is the lifebringing sun. He observes the creation with love.
Crunor, the great tree, is the father of all plantlife. He is a prominent god for many druids.
Nornur is the mysterious god of fate. Who knows if he is its creator or just a chronist?
Bastesh, the deep one, is the goddess of the sea and its creatures.
Kirok, the mad one, is the god of scientists and jesters.
Toth, Lord of Death, is the keeper of the souls, the guardian of the afterlife.
Banor, the heavenly warrior, is the patron of all fighters against evil. He is the gift of the gods to inspire humanity.
The gods we call the evil ones are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons!
Zathroth is the destructive aspect of magic. He is the deciver and the thief of souls.
Fafnar is the scorching sun. She observes the creation with hate and jealousy.
Brog, the raging one, is the great destroyer. The berserk of darkness.
The bonemaster Urgith is the lord of the undead and keeper of the damned souls.
The demons are followers of Zathroth. The cruelest are known as the ruthless seven.
I don't want to talk about that subject!

Welcome to my little shop, adventurer! First read my blackboards.

reply: Nope, not here.
We have too few crossbows on this isle for our hunters.
At the moment I have no weapons to offer. Weapons are very rare on this isle, so I have to buy a few.
It's a very nice isle. But we don't have enough weapons to defeat the many wolves.
They are everywhere around the village.
The magic shops have a monopole on potions now... argl!
I am Timur. Sorry, I have not much equipment for sale. The business is running low.

entries.text: Equipment and general goods!
Selling ammunition and buying bows and crossbows!

farewell: Yes, goodbye |PLAYERNAME|, just leave me alone.
greet: Uhm oh hello |PLAYERNAME|... not so loud please... my {head}... What ... do you {want}?

reply: I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
Uhhh ohhhh one of the beers yesterday must have been bad.
My Name? I am To... ahm... hum... My name is {Hugo}.
Yes, that's my name of course.
Uh .. I... I met a Todd on the road. He told me he was traveling to Venore, look there for your Todd.
I love that city.
I never was there. Now leave me alone.
Resistance is futile... uhm... I wonder where I picked that saying up. Oh my head...
I don't know anything about money, missing or not.
He often comes here. But his constant confusion gives me a worse headache than Frodo's beer. I rather avoid him.
Uhm, never heard about him... and you can't prove otherwise.
Thats a common name, perhaps I met a William, not sure about that.
Oh, this headache, one of the beers Frodo served me must have been foul.
I am a honest person and don't like to be insulted!
I am fine, thank you.
The soil is a bit dry and there are a lot of stones. It's very hard to work this soil.
It's relatively peaceful here.
Here are no dungeons as far as I know.
I know nothing but about such stuff.
I know nothing but about such stuff.
I know nothing but about such stuff.
I have not seen much of it yet. I am thinking about moving to Edron soon.
The city is too lousy and crowded for my taste.
They say life is easy there, the soil is rich, the city save. One day I might move there.
My name is Tokel.
I wish I'd be as rich as him.
Oh, now that you mention it: I have much left to do, please excuse me.
I am a farmer, and proud of it.
I pray to Crunor to bless our harvests.
My name is Tom the tanner.
I'm the local {tanner}. I buy fresh animal {corpses}, tan them, and convert them into fine leather clothes which I then sell to {merchants}.
{Dixi} and {Lee'Delle} sell my leather clothes in their shops.
That's my job. It can be dirty at times but it provides enough income for my living.
Do I look like a tourist information centre? Go ask someone else.
Help? I will give you a few gold coins if you have some fresh dead {animals} for me. Note the word {fresh}.
Fresh means: shortly after their death.
Much to do these days.
Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
Dungeons can be dangerous without proper {equipment}.
You need at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
Sorry, I haven't been outside for a while, so I don't know.
Troll leather stinks. Can't use it.
I don't buy orcs. Their skin is too scratchy.
Are you crazy?!

Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle}.

He's an apple polisher.
Now that's an interesting woman.
He's a better cook than his cousin {Willie}, actually.
I kinda like him. At least he says what he thinks.
Yep.
He sticks his nose too much in books.
My mother?? Did you meet my mother??
I don't have a problem with him.
Typical pencil pusher.
It's in the academy, just above Seymour. Go there once you are level 8 to leave this place.
He is such a hypocrite.
I like her beer.
She buys my fine leather clothes.
I wonder what spectacular monsters he has found.
Her nose is a little high in the air, I think. She never shakes my hand.
I wonder if he's angry because his potion monopoly fell.
I'm not what you'd call a 'believer'.
He's okay.
He's okay.

send_trade: Sure, check what I buy.

entries.text: Buying fresh corpses of rats, rabbits and wolves.
Oh yeah, I'm also interested in wolf paws and bear paws.
Also buying minotaur leather.

greet: Hello hello! Always good to see fresh blood! What brings you here?

entries.text: Interesting reaction. Bloodcurdling. Must inspect further.
This is really sanguine!
Hmm... the conductors are too dry to transmit energy.
Ah, fresh blood. My favourite.

greet: Welcome, Sir.

reply: We would like to serve you some time.
A passage to Oskayaat? Shall we cast off?

entries.text: What a beautiful day for a little boat trip.

greet: Welcome back, Sir.

reply: We would like to serve you some time.
A passage to Ankrahmun? Shall we cast off?

entries.text: I don't feel safe here ... I hope we can return to Ankrahmun soon.

greet: Greetings, human being.

reply: My name is a secret. Sorry but I won't tell you.
I'm the {tooth fairy}. I would think that says it all. I took over the body of a {seagull}.
I'm a fae. A rather unique kind of {fae}, because - as I said - I have a special responsibility for mortal children's {milk teeth}.

Outside of our secret {realm} my {siblings} and I can't keep our true shape. If we want to travel other parts of the world, we must take over the bodies of animals. But we are causing them no harm and we just take control if necessary.

Some call us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the term fae. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret {realm}. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. As we tend to be secretive about our true nature I'm afraid I can't tell you more.
Something is threatening our realm. But I don't know the details. If you are interested you should talk to {Alkestios}.

We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
He's a brother of mine. He took it upon himself to kind of lead our mission in the outside world. You may find him south of {Ab'Dendriel}.
It's a place full of life, huge trees, lush plants and various animals.
This is the world we are living in - and this place here in particular is very strange, if you're asking me.
It's a place full of stone buildings and people. In addition, there is a small {child} waiting for a present. *sigh*.

Small creatures, the offspring of mortals like {humans}, {elves} or {dwarves}. They have the most colourful and vivid dreams. And they lose their first teeth when they grow. I gather these teeth and give them a present in return.
They inhabit these huge places filled with stone buildings. They call them towns, I guess. And they have children who are waiting for their presents. *sigh*.
They are inhabiting Ab'Dendriel and live in close touch with nature.
They are living underneath the earth and are ... digging. Or so I heard.

entries.text: I have to ... No, I don't dare ...
This is a very strange part of the world.
The children are waiting for their presents.

reply: Mhrm buchhh acha hnnn.
Glgl nhhh mahmooo glll.
Shmmm gahhh hnn uhhk hnm bahh.
A splendid day for a fancy conversation.

greet: Hello, dear |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you? If you need magical equipment such as {runes} or {wands}, just ask me for a {trade}.

reply: Sorry, but runes of this type can't be purchased here.
I'm just wonderful - thank you for asking.
If you want to find out about excalibug you should ask the more sinister characters in Thais, not a respectable woman like myself!
There is talk of a rebellion in Venore to gain independence from the Oppressor... I mean, King - of Thais. It can only help business.
Bless him, he stood, he fought, and then left his sanity on the battlefield.
I heard that he left the city because he couldn't bear the shame of being rejected as courtmage. But that's just a gossip.

Dungeons - dank cold places if you ask me. They lead to rusty armor, severe colds and death ... on the other hand you use a lot of runes there ... so just think about the treasures you'll surely find there.
Better buy and charge a lot of runes before facing any monster.
I can't tell much about that old monk.
I've never seen him at all. I only heard he's kind of the townsguards' chief or some such.
A marvellous city! Modern! Prosperous! Thais could learn a thing or two from Venore.
I went there on holiday once. Just goes to show that women are much better at running a place than men. King Tibianus could learn a thing or two from Queen Eloise.
You never know when you run out of mana. All the more reason to buy some good runes or potions.
I heard he was a thief. Good thing he was caught.
I'm all ears.
I'm all ears.
Ah, Knights ... can't expect much from those guys.
Who knows what the old man is up to in his hideout when no one is watching?
You should ask this guy Oswald about him ... or other pointless rumors.
The Thais sewerage system is a model of modern rat breeding and for some reason is very popular with young adventurers such as yourself.
I think he is a spy ... so I smile at him the whole day. He won't get anything out of me!
Magic will only protect you - a rune and some magic potions.
There is a power struggle between Venore and Thais.
Some call her the preying mantis - apparently she has killed over a dozen husbands already.
Sorry, we removed the old life and mana fluids from our assortment. However, we offer health, spirit and mana potions in up to four sizes, just ask me for a trade.
He hung around with that Partos a lot. I wouldn't be surprised if he's a thief too. He is not allowed to enter our markethall.
I only heard rumours about him - isn't he a hermit somewhere in the north?
I had one once. He should have bought better armor. Actually - he's upstairs.
<mutters> Here we go again ... Hail to King Tibianus! ... Don't make me do that again!
Time waits for no one! Not even you, sweetheart, so please do hurry up.
My name is Topsy.
He wanted to be the court jester but got upset when people laughed at him.
Ah yes ... Gorn ... the used-cart salesman of scrolls.
Gods - if we didn't have them, we would have invented them.
I'm all ears.
Ah, such a sweetie. A simple man, with simple tastes and a simple mind.
I sell runes as well as spirit, health and mana potions - your best friends in any dungeon!

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

entries.text: Runes, wands, rods, health and mana potions! Have a look!

greet: Greetings! This isn't the {time} to chitchat though.

entries.text: Hear me! Hear me! The mage Wyrdin in the Edron academy is looking for brave adventurers to undertake a task!
Hear me! Hear me! The postmaster's guild has open spots for aspiring postmen! Contact Kevin Postner at the post office in the plains south of Kazordoon!
Hear me! Hear me! The inquisition is looking for daring people to fight evil! Apply at the inquisition headquarters next to the Thaian jail!

reply: The king listens to the advice of this swordsman far too often.

Ah well. This matter was taken out of our hands for now. The inquisition insisted to control the collection of these stones and by royal decree they were granted the exclusive right to do so. ... As a simple scientist I'm not in a position to question such decision, as hard as it might hit my researches. For now I can not trade any of the stones. You will have to wait for another opportunity.
Some dumb holes for adventurers seeking trouble.
Some dumb holes for adventurers seeking trouble.
The last courtmage was killed by Ferumbras in one of his attacks.
He failed in his quest for power since he ultimately forfeited greater powers for a quick but limited powerboost by enslaving himself to some dark entities.
The only weapon I need is my magic.
Our king frequently relies on my divinations and spells of protection.
That old fool wanted to become courtmage too. But he just doesn't cut the mustard.
Many call themselves a sorcerer, but only a few truly understand what that means.
She has the 'know how', but sadly does not really know how to use it efficiently.
Mixing up magic with religion can't do any good.
The king listens to the advice of this swordsman far too often.
Limited in his vision as all knights are.
Since intelligence can't be substituted by passion, all druids are nothing but hedgemages.
He's quite good in magical theories, but lacks practice in the field.
Wisdom is only an excuse for the lack of consequence.
Brawns but no brain.
I have certainly no business with such persons.
A truly disgusting fellow.
I have certainly no business with such persons.
Our king frequently relies on my divinations and spells of protection.
Power comes to those who have the intelligence to claim it.
My spells are my personal secret.
A bar is fine to distract the mundanes from doing something foolish.
Paladins are another example that diversing one's resources between goods, mundane weapons, and magic does not make a good mixture.
He made the best he could of his limited abilities.
Another bogeyman. Who's afraid of someone who is that 'powerful' that he hides in some dirthole?
I am commonly known as Trimegis.
Time does not matter in the end.
In the long run, it would pay off to focus all resources on a magicians corps, but the king is not convinced of that. Not yet. At least one mundane who knows his proper place.
I have no need for runes anymore. Runes are tools for beginners.
I don't care about mundane gossip.
I am the kings new courtmage and advisor in arcane matters.
A man as mundane as a rock.

farewell: Don't hurt yourself with that weapon, little one.

reply: Would you like to learn {lesser front sweep} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {great light} magic spell for 500 gold?
Would you like to learn {wound cleansing} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {bruise bane} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {cure poison} magic spell for 150 gold?
Would you like to learn {find fiend} magic spell for 1000 gold?
Would you like to learn {find person} magic spell for 80 gold?
Would you like to learn {light} magic spell for free?
I can teach you {healing} spells and {support} spells. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? I can also tell you which spells are available at your {level}.
My healing spells are: {Bruise Bane}, {Cure Poison} and {Wound Cleansing}.
My support spells are: {Find Fiend}, {Find Person}, {Great Light}, {Lesser Front Sweep} and {Light}.
For level 25 I have {Find Fiend} for 1000 gold.
For level 13 I have {Great Light} for 500 gold.
For level 10 I have {Cure Poison} for 150 gold.
For level 8 I have {Find Person} for 80 gold, {Light} for free and {Wound Cleansing} for free.
For level 1 I have {Bruise Bane} for free and {Lesser Front Sweep} for free.
I have spells for level {1}, {8}, {10}, {13} and {25}.

greet: Hello, dear |PLAYERNAME|. Can I be of any assistance? Just tell me if you'd like to {trade} weapons or armor.

reply: Aah... a beautiful leafy city. Shame about the elves.
I'm just fine and dandy, thank you for asking.
I am not a mere assistant! I have a job of great responsibility! But mostly I keep annoying personages away from my boss.
You need to shrink before you go there - they say the dwarves aren't too keen on sharing their mountain with us Tibians.
Well, Venore is richer than Thais, and some people want to live in a democracy free from an oppressive tyrant - I mean monarch. I'm not one of them.
There's always some gossip on the street about him. I've never met him in person though. I guess he doesn't need many weapons.
Oh gosh - I could tell you some stories. But I won't.
Ah, such a shame about poor Benjamin. Lost it a bit after receiving one too many blows to the head.
I have never heard any rumours concerning him, isn't that odd?
You know a rumour? Well then - don't keep it to yourself.
The word on the street is that Sam does not forge all his weapons himself, but buys them from his cousin, who is married to a cyclops.
If you want to see dungeons go and insult the guards. On second thoughts - don't do that.
There is a monster here? HERE?! Time to double the prices!
You can't teach an old monk new tricks. He is stubborn to the extreme and overly concerned about Thais. He should care more about his gods and less about that king.
You know a rumour? Well then - don't keep it to yourself.
Ah... Venore - a wonderful city! Full of culture! So many friendly faces! So unlike Thais!
Those women really know how to run things - look at how well the trade is going there!
Spells - dodgy mumbo jumbo if you ask me. A sword never backfires on its user!
Some thief they caught for all I know.
Magic is a thing of the past. Why bother with a colourful bit of rock and a few fancy words when you can have a foot of razor-sharp steel in your hand?!
Shhh! He's a spy! He watches us all the time! Just keep smiling and he'll go away!
Thais is OK - I suppose. Not as nice as Venore, but good for business.
Elves are good with a bow and arrow, or so I am told. Shame that they are no good at peace-making.
It is very effective, but attracts almost as many wannabe heroes as it does rats.
Well - she isn't really my kind of person. Please don't mention her name again.
There are people who talk about a rebellion against King Tibianus.
I don't know much about them - there are some civilised dwarves, of course, but I can never tell whether they are male or female.
A true tragedy - she has lost so many husbands in such unusual circumstances.
Some sinister guy that is. He's not allowed to enter that markethall and that's for a good reason.
Some call me Turvy. Actually, everybody calls me Turvy.
You know a rumour? Well then - don't keep it to yourself.
Ah, yes, yes, hail to King Tibianus! May he in his infinite wisdom reduce my taxes... and so on...
It is nearly time for my afternoon nap, so please hurry!
Bozo - such a tragic story. If only I could remember it.
He does a good line in second-rate scrolls for first-rate prices.
It is an absolute honour to provide weaponry and armor to the courageous adventurers of Thais, just so long as you have the gold to pay for it.
A simple shopkeeper, who was last in the queue when they were handing out intelligence.
The Gods of Tibia play games with the fate of Tibians - but they haven't bothered to read the instructions.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my offers.

entries.text: Courageous adventurers, come buy your weapons and armors here!

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

farewell: Mind the sky once in a while.
greet: Greetings, two-leg.

reply: Udu. Astronomer, insomniac, and the only one here who looks up.
I watch the sky above Marapur every night and write down what it does.
The stars are reliable. It is everything else that keeps surprising me.
East of Marapur, out where the water goes green. That is where it came down.
Whatever the priests say, something tore loose from her that night.

walkaway: Mind the sky once in a while.

greet: Spirits welcome you.
Greetings hero. I guess you came to {talk}.
Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Lovely steamboat, ain't it? I can even offer you a {passage} if you like.

reply: <the dwarf just shrugs>
<the dwarf smiles slightly, shows you a piece of paper with |TRAVELCOST| written on it, as expecting a {yes} or {no}>
<the dwarf just shrugs>
<the dwarf smiles slightly, shows you a piece of paper with |TRAVELCOST| written on it, as expecting a {yes} or {no}>
<the dwarf quizzically raises his brow - the only destinations he accepts seems to be {Cormaya} or {Kazordoon}>

greet: Hiho |PLAYERNAME|! Wanna weapon, eh?
Daraman's blessings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Edron for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Darashia on Darama for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Darashia on Darama for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Svargrond for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Kazordoon for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Kazordoon for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you seek a ride to Issavi for |TRAVELCOST|?
I am known as Uzon Ibn Kalith.
I am a licensed Darashian carpet pilot. I can bring you to {Darashia}, {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond} or {Edron}.
The caliph welcomes travellers to his land.
The caliph welcomes travellers to his land.
Oh, there is so much to tell about Daraman. You better travel to Darama to learn about his teachings.
I would never transport this one.
So you heard about haunted Drefia? Many adventures travel there to test their skills against the undead: vampires, mummies, and ghosts.
Some people claim it is hidden somewhere under the endless sands of the devourer desert in Darama.
Thais is noisy and overcrowded. That's why I like Darashia more.
I have seen almost every place on the continent.
I could retell the tales of my travels for hours. Sadly another flight is scheduled soon.
Just another Thais but with women to lead them.
You can buy flying carpets only in Darashia.
I transport travellers to the continent of Darama for a small fee. So many want to see the wonders of the desert and learn the secrets of Darama.
I heard too many news to recall them all.
I heard too many news to recall them all.
I can fly you to {Darashia} on Darama, {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond}, {Issavi}, {Farmine} or {Edron} if you like. Where do you want to go?
I can fly you to {Darashia} on Darama, {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond} or {Edron} if you like. Where do you want to go?
I can fly you to {Darashia} on Darama, {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond} or {Edron} if you like. Where do you want to go?
I can fly you to {Darashia} on Darama, {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond} or {Edron} if you like. Where do you want to go?
It's 3:42 pm right now. The next flight is scheduled soon.

entries.text: Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!

greet: Daraman's blessings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: You shouldn't miss the experience.
Can we finally leave this cursed place?
I am known as Uzon Ibn Kalith.
I transport travellers to the continent of Darama for a small fee. So many want to see the wonders of the desert and learn the secrets of Darama.
I heard too many news to recall them all.
I heard too many news to recall them all.
It's 3:42 pm right now. The next flight is scheduled soon.

entries.text: Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides!

farewell: Please come back from time to time.
greet: Welcome to Valentine's Store. Let's {trade} something?

reply: I am known as the saleswoman of love, as a cupid.
I grew up in Greenshore, I spent most of my time here and it is very likely that I will die here. Greenshore is a lovely place.
Sometimes, the wind takes the choral singing of the monks to our coast. I alway get goosebumps when I hear it. It's so beautiful.
He has so many followers but <whispers> I think he is doing a bad job. He should do more against the crimes happening right in front of his nose.
It's not very far to the Isle of Solitude from here but there is simply no way. Isn't that a little bit odd?!?
All flowers around Greenshore have been grown by myself.
Sometimes, when the air is crystal clear, you can see it from the shore.
You must know, many people came here to look for an underground passage to the Isle of Solitude. The people of Greenshore believe that there is one but no one ever proved its existence.
It's sad to see how it changed. As a child I used to go there regularly but today I avoid going there. It's no safe place for an old woman like me.
The ocean is part of Greenshore. The sound of the sea lapping against the shore, the salty air and the vastness when you look at the horizon <sigh> - it's so peaceful.
What should I tell you? I'm old and I've got many things to tell even if most of them apply to Greenshore and its surrounding, the ocean and its islands offshore.
Love is the most important thing in the world and I help you to express it. Just ask me about my offers and I'll tell you what you can buy.
He has so many followers but <whispers> I think he is doing a bad job. He should do more against the crimes happening right in front of his nose.
The ocean is part of Greenshore. The sound of the sea lapping against the shore, the salty air and the vastness when you look at the horizon <sigh> - it's so peaceful.

entries.text: Love is beautiful, we are loved.

walkaway: Please come back from time to time.

greet: Greetings hero. I guess you came to {talk}.

entries.text: Talk to me if you want to help protecting the village.
Rookgaard needs your help more than ever.

greet: Hello, small one.

reply: I am known as Vasko.
My role here is quest contact.
My name is Vera. I sell furniture and equipment.
Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
You mean my specials, don't you?
I have beds, chairs, containers, decoration, flowers, instruments, pillows, pottery, statues, tapestries and tables. Which of those would you like to see?

entries.text: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.

walkaway: Oh, two t-trolls. Hellooo, wittle twolls. <hicks>

greet: Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Are you here to {learn} new wisdom or do you have time for a {mission}?

reply: My name is Viola, I am the spelltrainer here in Newhaven. So if you're interested in new spells, let me know.
Due to my knowledge in multiple different fields, I became a trainer for all vocations, teaching them some new spells.
Our little island once had a strong economy based on the mines. Lots of workers came from overseas to work here. I still remember that beautiful harbour we had here, good old times.
The mainland with its capital Thais.
A good friend of mine used to live there, such a beautiful city. I always enjoyed my stay at Kingsday tho', can't recommend it enough.
The king's castle is in Thais, make sure to visit it someday.
Avriel takes care of our little shop just west from my house. When you're looking for supplies or want to sell stuff, you should talk to him.
Anna always enjoyed the thrill of the open sea. She often supplies Avriels shop with goods for all of us. Then you're ready to leave I suggest talking to her.
Flavius is the banker on our island. When you need any financial advice, you will find him just north of my house.
Ahh, yes my dearest Gustavo. He's the guard of our little village protecting us from the muglex. If you're interested in helping, you should talk to him.
He once visited over from Thais, I heard Gustavo and him are are good friends.
You can find the shop just east of here. Avriel will get you going with everything you need.
The bank can be found just north of us. Flavius will take care of all your financial needs.
Gustavo serves as our guard, keeping us safe from the northern part of the island. It can get pretty dangerous there, take care if you ever find yourself there.
Those muglex have been terrorising our little village for a while now, maybe you could talk to Gustavo. I bet he knows more about them.
These little green goblins once arrived with ships, ever since our village has been under constant attack. Fortunately the wooden walls and Gustavo are keeping the danger out.
These mines were once a thriving force for workers and investors alike, ever since the last ores have been mined, these trenches have been abandoned for good.
I see you are eager to learn new spells.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Ah, a visitor. Allow me to introduce myself. Wayland Smythers, in service of science. I am here in search of esteemed heroes, such as yourself, to avert a grave {danger}.

reply: I am but a humble messenger, sent by a scientist in desperate need. Please, {hear} me out. I have no intention to deceive you.
The one who sent me is none other than Doctor {Marrow}. I know his name carries a certain weight, so to speak. Yet what he faces now threatens far more than his reputation.
You may have noticed the unrest of the spheres. Their harmony has been disturbed for some time, and a recent {spherequake} has even shaken the moon itself.
Fragments of the moon have fallen upon Tibia. Not mere stone, but something far more peculiar. Within them lies a substance known as {moonsilver}.
A metal of strange and unsettling properties. It hums with power not meant for this world. Naturally, many factions seek to claim it. A particularly large fragment lies on the island of {Thalassara}.
They flock there like vultures, blinded by greed. My mentor, however, was less restrained by organisational formalities and secured a modest {headstart}.

And in doing so, he uncovered something dreadful. The moonsilver is not merely a resource to be claimed. Its presence coincides with something that has taken form. Something that should not exist. That is the {threat} we are facing.
The others do not see it. They quarrel, scheme and sabotage one another, deaf to warnings. And Doctor Marrow, well, his {reputation} does him no favors.
Call him erratic, call him dangerous, call him what you will. I call him right. This time, your path and his will {align}.
He has been taken. A cunning and malevolent {entity} holds him captive. It grows stronger with each passing day, feeding on something I dare not name.
If left unchecked, it will not stop at the island. You must {find} Doctor Marrow and free him. Only he understands how this horror may be undone.
I can arrange passage for you. Quietly. As a stowaway bound for Thalassara. Once there, you must earn the trust, or at least the tolerance, of the factions present. Then you can safely {proceed}.
Head south, where the fallen fragment scarred the land. The air itself feels wrong there. You will encounter the servants of the one who keeps the doctor {captive}.
They will not welcome you. You must take from them what you need to breach their {stronghold}. Subtlety is optional. Effectiveness is not.
Within, you will find the doctor. Free him, and he will guide you {further}. He has seen things. Learned things.
Wayland Smythers, in service of science.
I am an assistant. A messenger. A man who carries other men's brilliance from one place to another without dropping it.
White robes, empty eyes and absolute conviction. A dreadful combination in any century.
It used to be a comfort in the night sky. Now a piece of it sits on Thalassara, humming.
A remarkable apparatus. The moonsilver here does not merely endure changing intent, it responds to directed intent. Doctor Marrow understood that long before anyone else did.
If you have the ingredients, I can channel the power of this place into swords, axes, clubs, bows, crossbows, wands, rods and katars.
But please know that this is only possible for unfused equipment that has not been treated at the Exaltation Forge.
If you have collected enough radiant attire scraps, I can arrange the creation of an Illuminated Warrior for you.
The full outfit requires 2500 scraps. Each addon requires 1250 more. Are you interested in the {basic} outfit, the {insignia}, or the {halo} helmet?

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

reply: We can {change} money for you. You can also access your {bank account}.

There are three different coin types in Tibia: 100 gold coins equal 1 platinum coin, 100 platinum coins equal 1 crystal coin. So if you'd like to change 100 gold into 1 platinum, simply say '{change gold}' and then '1 platinum'.
We can {change} money for you. You can also access your {bank account}.
Your bank account will be used automatically when you want to {rent} a house or place an offer on an item on the {market}. Let me know if you want to know about how either one works.

greet: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME| If you need magical equipment such as {runes} or {wands}, just ask me for a {trade}.

reply: Sorry, but runes of this type can't be purchased here.
Sorry, we removed the old life and mana fluids from our assortment. However, we offer health, spirit and mana potions in up to four sizes, just ask me for a trade.
Sorry, we removed the old life and mana fluids from our assortment. However, we offer health, spirit and mana potions in up to four sizes, just ask me for a trade.
Eclesius is a good old friend of mine.
There is a sorcerer guild in Thais. Just go to the south west of the town, it is easy to find.
I'm Xodet, the owner of this shop.
I'm a sorcerer and trade all kinds of magic items.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at potions, wands or runes?

greet: Who are you? Are you a genius in mechanics? You don't look like one.

send_trade: At your service, just browse through my wares.

reply: Yes, he's my cousin. He also collects rare tokens, but unlike me he's interested in silver tokens. Call this passion something of a family trait.

You might find my cousin Cledwyn downstairs on the main floor. We're all interested in rare tokens, always on the move to offer our services in exchange for these treasures. ... There's a kind of a competition on who's the most successful token hunter. If you should have any gold tokens with you, we could make a deal.
I'm Yana O'Reilly, bespoke smith and a token trader. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Yes, that's my name. My mother chose it, it means prudence or cunningness in some old and almost forgotten Tibian language.

I'm collecting rare tokens made of metal or gemstones. At the moment, I'm interested in gold tokens. If you should happen to have some with you, I could exchange them for special weapons of different types.

entries.text: Trading tokens! First-class equipment available!

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

reply: Call me Yeo.
Looks like fishing, doesn' it? Mending nets, boats, fishing for clams... yup, sounds like a fisherman's job to me.
Good town for tradesmen and artisans. Interesting stuff they do with glooth, nowadays.

greet: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?

reply: I have {beds}, {chairs}, {containers}, {decoration}, {flowers}, {instruments}, {pillows}, {pottery}, {statues}, {tapestries} and {tables}. Which of those would you like to see?

send_trade: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?

entries.text: Beds, chairs, tables, statues and everything you could imagine for decorating your home!

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

reply: Zerbrus, at your service.
I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
Before you fight monsters, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.
Fine.
I have to stay here, sorry. But I can {heal} you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
I'm not a gossiper, but if you want to know something about a certain Rookgaardian, ask.
They're not that dangerous, but don't let yourself get cornered by many of them. They still can hurt.
There are two types of spiders on this island: normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!
Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
The orcs have a hideout under the troll cave, just descend deep. Still, be very careful!
Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner monsters.
The skeletons on this island are usually fairly hidden. They are often found near graves and always underground. Beware of their evil life drain.
There is a bear cave close to this bridge. Be careful, though, they hit hard!
Wasp hives exist only behind the north bridge, so ask {Dallheim} for information. I'm glad there are no wasps here. They always make me jump.
Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.
Premium warriors pay. They gain many advantages this way.
HAIL TO THE KING!
It's north of the temple.
A place of protection. Nothing can harm you there.
I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
There are {wolves}, {bears}, {snakes}, {deer}, and {spiders} in the wilderness past this bridge.
I'm a follower of {Banor}.
The heavenly warrior! Read {books} to learn about him.
You will learn about magic soon enough.
In the world of Tibia, many challenges await the brave adventurer.
There are many books in the {academy}. Theory can be just as important as practice.
It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.

At your service.

greet: Be greeted my .. {guezt}.
Another visitor to this constricted, cosy, calm realm, perfect except for an {exit}. Muhaha.

reply: I wait. I wait for someone like you to come here. I wait for them to grow disconsolate. I wait for them to despair. And I wait for them to die. Muhahaha.
I am Zumtah, Zumtah the impeccable, Zumtah the marvellous, Zumtah the... the... eternal.
I am Zumtah, Zumtah the impeccable, Zumtah the marvellous, Zumtah the... the... eternal.
I am Zumtah, Zumtah the impeccable, Zumtah the marvellous, Zumtah the... the... eternal.
The land you are currently dwelling in, human. Don't you have any sense of your surroundings?
I have seen many of them. I have seen many of them die. In here, with me. Perhaps you will be pleased to meet them. Not long and you will join their ranks. Muhaha.
Pesky creatures. Many of them have been brought here, many of them died here. Humans, lizards, beasts, they all die the same. Down here, with me. Muhahaha.
What? What do you mean by that?
Hmm, an old one. I don't care much about politics or power, as here, he has none. Here, only I have power. Muhaha.
What are you talking about, such things do not matter down here. Down here alone, isolated and broken. Muhaha.
